The new rules are significantly stricter than previous regulations and aim to push young people towards more productive pursuits.

title: Walt Disney Co., Warner Bros. Contribute To Gavin Newsom Effort To Fend Off Recall Election — Update
summary: Warner Bros. and Walt Disney Co. are among several Hollywood studios contributing to California Governor Gavin Newsom's campaign to fend off a recall election. Warner Bros. donated $40,000, while Disney previously contributed $32,400 to his reelection campaign, despite earlier friction over theme park reopening restrictions. Public polls show Newsom leading by double digits against the recall effort, and his campaign has a significant financial advantage.

title: From facing rejections to being laid off to Country Counsel & Company Secretary at Boeing, India: Meet Dr. Akhil Prasad
summary: Dr. Akhil Prasad shares his journey from initial rejections and financial struggles to becoming the Country Counsel and Company Secretary at Boeing, India. His story highlights the importance of continuous learning, perseverance through personal and professional setbacks including losing his father and being laid off, and strategic upskilling that ultimately led to his success in global corporations. He emphasizes that life is full of obstacles, and those who keep learning and striving will succeed.

title: The Walt Disney Company Announces Reimagine Tomorrow Diversity Initiative
summary: The Walt Disney Company has launched its "Reimagine Tomorrow" initiative, aiming to amplify underrepresented voices and stories. This includes commitments to diverse on-screen representation, charitable giving, and supplier spending, alongside expanding the "Disney Look" for Cast Members to be more inclusive. The initiative intends to champion accurate representation in media and entertainment.

title: Marvel Studios’ ‘Shang-Chi and The Legend of The Ten Rings’ Debuts at No. 1 with $132.3 Million Globally
summary: Marvel Studios' "Shang-Chi and The Legend of The Ten Rings" opened as the No. 1 movie globally, earning an estimated $132.3 million. The film set a record for the highest Labor Day weekend opening and received exceptional critical and audience ratings, including a 92% Certified Fresh score on Rotten Tomatoes. Starring Simu Liu, Awkwafina, Michelle Yeoh, and Tony Leung, the movie was directed by Destin Daniel Cretton.

title: Adi Dhandhania explains how Bally’s hit the big time - Management - iGB
summary: Adi Dhandhania, Senior Vice President of Strategy and Interactive at Bally’s, details the company's rapid expansion in 2021 through significant acquisitions and partnerships in both land-based and interactive gaming. Bally's strategic focus includes acquiring casino properties, sports betting technology, daily fantasy platforms, and free-to-play game providers, alongside major media partnerships like the Sinclair Broadcast Group deal and the pending Gamesys Group acquisition. The company aims to become a premier global omni-channel gaming entity by leveraging these assets and expanding into key US states with favorable regulatory frameworks for online sports betting and iGaming.

title: Disney+ Sets Launch Date for South Korea
summary: Disney+ has announced its launch date for South Korea as November 12, with a monthly cost of KRW 9,900 or an annual fee of KRW 99,000. Additionally, Disney's streaming service in Japan will be enhanced with Star-branded content starting October 27. These moves are a crucial part of Disney's global expansion strategy in East Asian markets.

title: 'Halloween Kills' to debut on Peacock and in theaters
summary: Universal Pictures announced that "Halloween Kills" will be released simultaneously on its streaming service, Peacock, and in theaters on October 15. This move aims to boost Peacock's subscription numbers by offering fresh content, following a similar strategy used for "Boss Baby: Family Business." Horror films have proven to be strong draws, both in cinemas and for streaming platforms.

title: Disney Announces Exclusive Theatrical Windows for Remaining 2021 Slate of Films
summary: Disney Media & Entertainment Distribution announced exclusive theatrical release windows for its remaining 2021 films. "Encanto" will have a 30-day exclusive theatrical release before moving to Disney+ for the holidays, while other films like "Eternals" and "West Side Story" will have a minimum 45-day exclusive theatrical run. This strategy aims to cater to improving cinema confidence while providing flexibility for Disney+ subscribers.

title: Disney to debut rest of 2021 films exclusively in theaters
summary: Walt Disney Co announced that its remaining 2021 film slate, including "Eternals" and "West Side Story," will be released exclusively in theaters before becoming available for streaming. This decision signals Disney's confidence in the rebound of moviegoing, although animated musical "Encanto" will have a 30-day theatrical window before heading to Disney+. The move comes as cinema operators hope for strong fall and winter titles to attract audiences back to multiplexes.

title: Fox acquires celebrity news specialist TMZ from AT&T’s WarnerMedia
summary: Fox Corp. has acquired celebrity news platform TMZ from AT&T Inc.’s WarnerMedia unit, aiming to expand its digital media and unscripted content portfolio. The terms of the deal were undisclosed, but TMZ was reportedly valued at less than $50 million, lower than earlier estimates. TMZ co-founder Harvey Levin will remain in charge of operations, and the acquisition is expected to create new growth opportunities for the celebrity news specialist.

title: Starbucks Next to Disney World Sells For Unheard of $6 Million
summary: A Starbucks near Walt Disney World recently sold for $5.9 million, approximately twice the usual price for a Starbucks in Central Florida. This indicates the significant long-term value investors place on real estate adjacent to the internationally famous theme park, driven by Disney's continued growth. The sale also highlights the economic boon Disney World provides to the surrounding Orlando neighborhoods.

title: Walt Disney Company Head of Investor Relations, Lowell Singer, to Join Acrisure as CFO
summary: Lowell Singer, previously Senior Vice President of Investor Relations at The Walt Disney Company for 14 years, has been appointed as the Chief Financial Officer of Acrisure, a rapidly growing fintech leader and global insurance broker. Singer will be responsible for Acrisure's financial activities and will contribute to the company's aggressive growth strategy, which includes expanding into Asset Management and Cyber Security. His tenure at Disney saw the company's market capitalization increase significantly, and Acrisure expects to reach $3 billion in revenue by the end of 2021.

title: Delta’s Extra $200 Insurance Fee Shows Vaccine Dilemma for Employers (Published 2021)
summary: Delta Air Lines has implemented a policy requiring unvaccinated employees to pay an additional $200 per month for health insurance, starting November 1. This move, which comes after one vaccine received full federal approval, represents a distinct approach compared to companies mandating vaccines. Delta states this is to increase vaccination rates and noted that recent COVID-19 hospitalizations among its employees were all unvaccinated, costing the company approximately $50,000 per stay.

title: Walt Disney Company Purchases Roughly 60 Acres for Lake Nona Campus
summary: The Walt Disney Company has reportedly purchased approximately 60 acres of land in Lake Nona, Florida, for $46 million, moving forward with its plan to establish a new campus there. This campus is expected to relocate 2,000 jobs from California and involves an $864 million investment by Disney. Construction on the office building is anticipated to be completed by November 2022.

title: With over $5m investment to date, Visionary Media Group wants to create ‘revolutionary experiences for top-tier artists’
summary: Nashville-based Visionary Media Group has secured over $5 million in investment from its parent company, Visionary Private Equity Group (VPEG). The company aims to create revolutionary experiences for top-tier artists and build technological tools, such as the upcoming social distribution platform Evernova, to empower creatives to tell their stories. Founding managing partners Ronald Zamber and Nick Sciorra emphasize their mission to democratize media and provide a platform for all artists and creatives to connect and advance their work.

title: EXCLUSIVE Netflix offers free plan in Kenya to entice new subscribers
summary: Netflix has launched a free mobile plan in Kenya, offering about a quarter of its content, to attract new subscribers in a key African market. This strategy aims to convert free users to paid subscriptions, particularly as growth slows in more saturated markets like the US. The initiative highlights Netflix's focus on international expansion and investment in local programming to grow its global subscriber base.

title: Disney Is Harnessing The Power Of Influencers With Its ‘Disney Creators Lab’
summary: The Walt Disney Company has launched the 'Disney Creators Lab,' an initiative to guide and train 20 existing social media influencers who promote its brand. This program aims to create a more efficient system for integrating creators into Disney's marketing efforts, offering them online courses on branding, merchandising, and content monetization. While Disney does not directly pay participants, the influencers gain skills that can lead to future financial revenue through brand sponsorships.

title: SiriusXM Launches New Free Channel and Premium Podcast Subscription with Marvel Entertainment on Apple Podcasts
summary: SiriusXM and Marvel Entertainment have partnered to launch Marvel Podcasts Unlimited, a premium audio subscription available exclusively on Apple Podcasts. This service offers subscribers early and exclusive access to new scripted and unscripted Marvel podcast series, including "Marvel's Wastelanders" and the Spanish-language adaptation of "Marvel's Wolverine: The Long Night." Additionally, a free Marvel channel on Apple Podcasts will feature popular existing series.

title: The Walt Disney Company Celebrates Disney+ Day on November 12 to Thank Subscribers with New Content, Fan Experiences, and More
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced Disney+ Day for November 12, a global celebration to thank its subscribers with new content releases across its major brands. This event will include premieres such as Marvel Studios’ Shang-Chi and The Legend of The Ten Rings, Disney’s Jungle Cruise, and new Disney+ Original movie Home Sweet Home Alone, alongside special fan experiences at Disney Parks and beyond. Additionally, Disney+ will launch in South Korea, Taiwan, and Hong Kong around this date, expanding its global reach.

title: The Walt Disney Company Celebrates Disney+ Day on November 12 to Thank Subscribers with New Content, Fan Experiences, and More
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced Disney+ Day, a global celebration on November 12, featuring new content releases across its brands for subscribers. This event, which will also mark the expansion of Disney+ into new Asia-Pacific markets, will include special promotions and experiences across Disney Parks, Resorts, Cruise Line, and shopDisney. Bob Chapek stated that Disney+ Day will be an annual tentpole event aimed at entertaining, informing, and inspiring fans worldwide.

title: Thousands of Netgear routers can be hacked — here's what to do
summary: A serious security flaw in Netgear Nighthawk routers, stemming from the Disney-designed Circle parental-control feature, leaves thousands of devices vulnerable to hacking. Eleven different Nighthawk models are affected, and users are urged to update their router firmware immediately to patch the vulnerability. The flaw allows remote attackers with network access to gain control of the router due to unencrypted Circle update files.

title: Netflix Acquires Roald Dahl Story Company
summary: Netflix has acquired the Roald Dahl Story Company for an undisclosed figure, gaining access to the author's full catalog of works. This acquisition expands on an existing relationship and allows Netflix to create a universe of content across various media based on Dahl's properties. The deal aims to delight global audiences for generations to come with new adaptations of beloved stories like "Charlie and the Chocolate Factory" and "Matilda."

title: Brian Roberts: Comcast is ‘Really a Broadband Company’
summary: Comcast chairman/CEO Brian Roberts stated that Comcast has transformed into a broadband company, having accumulated 33 million customers and adding about 1 million broadband subscribers annually for two decades. This growth greatly offsets declines in cable TV subscriptions. Roberts emphasized the company's focus on deepening broadband relationships through enhanced connectivity and new devices like XiOne, positioning Comcast as a leader in the evolving high-speed Internet landscape.

title: Netflix acquires Roald Dahl Story Company
summary: Netflix announced it is acquiring the Roald Dahl Story Company (RDSC), which manages the rights to Roald Dahl's works. This move signifies one of Netflix's largest content acquisitions and a shift towards owning intellectual property outright rather than just licensing. The acquisition aims to create a "unique universe" across various media from Dahl's popular stories, including "Matilda" and "Willy Wonka."

title: THE WALT DISNEY COMPANY CELEBRATES DISNEY+ DAY ON NOVEMBER 12 TO THANK SUBSCRIBERS WITH NEW CONTENT, FAN EXPERIENCES, AND MORE
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced Disney+ Day will be held on November 12, a global celebration to thank subscribers with new content releases across its major brands, fan experiences, and promotions. The event will include premieres like "Shang-Chi and The Legend of The Ten Rings" and "Home Sweet Home Alone," along with a special presentation for fans and the expansion of Disney+ into new Asia-Pacific markets.

title: Walt Disney Co. Won’t Pursue Independent Investigation Of Sexual Assault Claims — Report
summary: The Walt Disney Co. has decided against launching an independent investigation into sexual assault allegations against former "Good Morning America" producer Michael Corn. This decision comes despite ABC News President Kim Godwin's earlier wish for such a probe, reportedly due to the ongoing litigation surrounding the claims. Michael Corn denies the allegations made by Kirstyn Crawford and Jill McClain.

title: New report shows coronavirus pandemic's impact on attendance at Disneyland, Universal Studios and other theme parks
summary: A new report reveals that theme park attendance in Southern California plummeted over 80% year-over-year in 2020 due to the coronavirus pandemic and government-mandated shutdowns. Disneyland, Universal Studios Hollywood, and other major parks experienced significant declines in visitor numbers. Despite the severe impact, the report indicates a slow but sure rebound, particularly in domestic tourism, as parks reopened and met pent-up demand.

title: Disney Springs Exclusive Vera Bradley Bonjour Belle Collection Debuts Today
summary: Vera Bradley has launched a new "Bonjour Belle" collection, inspired by Disney's Beauty and the Beast, exclusively at their Disney Springs location. The collection features bags and accessories. Fans can purchase items directly at the store or place a phone order.

title: Netflix VP Of Communications Richard Siklos Leaves The Company
summary: Richard Siklos, Netflix's VP of communications since 2017, has announced his departure from the streaming giant. His exit follows other executive changes at Netflix, which has seen significant growth in recent years and has maintained its leadership in the streaming market despite increased competition. Siklos previously held a senior communications role at Time Warner and had a notable career as a journalist specializing in the media business.

title: Apple claimed it had less than 20 million TV+ subscribers in July, showbiz union says
summary: A showbiz union, the International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees (IATSE), claims Apple stated it had under 20 million Apple TV+ subscribers in the U.S. and Canada as of July 1. This allowed Apple to pay lower rates to production crews under a contract provision for streaming services with fewer than 20 million subscribers. The union is currently in negotiations for a new contract and is considering a strike, arguing that streaming platforms, despite their profitability, are still leveraging outdated contract terms.

title: LG Uplus to offer Disney+ to IPTV users
summary: LG Uplus, a major South Korean mobile carrier, announced a deal with Walt Disney Company Korea to offer Disney+ on its U+tv IPTV platform. This move aims to boost its competitiveness against rivals like KT Corp. and SK Telecom ahead of Disney+'s November launch in South Korea. The partnership will also provide easier access to Disney+ for LG Uplus's 4G LTE and 5G mobile users, intensifying competition in the country's streaming market currently dominated by Netflix.

title: Delta Airlines Officially Proposes a NEW No-Fly List For Unruly Passengers
summary: Delta Airlines has proposed a new no-fly list specifically for unruly passengers, expanding on the existing one which primarily targets individuals considered high-risk for violent or terroristic behavior. The airline already has over 1,600 people on its internal no-fly list and has shared over 600 names with the FAA in 2021. This initiative aims to enhance safety for airline employees and passengers, with Delta encouraging other airlines to share their own banned lists to prevent problematic individuals from flying with different carriers.

title: The Walt Disney Company & ESPN To Televise, Stream NHL in 109 Countries Globally Beginning with 2021-22 Season
summary: The Walt Disney Company and ESPN are set to broadcast and stream NHL games in 109 countries globally, starting with the 2021-22 season, as part of a recent rights deal. Coverage will be available across various Disney and ESPN platforms including Star+, ESPN Player, and the ESPN App, making NHL content accessible to millions of fans worldwide. This comprehensive coverage will include the Stanley Cup Final, Stanley Cup Playoffs, NHL All-Star, and regular season games.

title: Southwest Airlines And Walt Disney World Resort Celebrate 50th Anniversary Of Both Iconic Brands With Commemorative Aircraft
summary: Southwest Airlines and Walt Disney World Resort are celebrating their 50th anniversaries with a special co-branded commemorative aircraft, a Boeing 737-700 featuring anniversary logos and an EARidescent treatment. The collaboration also includes a "50 Days of Giveaways" sweepstakes offering vacation packages and exclusive inflight entertainment content related to Walt Disney World Resort's 50th-anniversary celebration. The special aircraft will fly around the Southwest system through March 2022, allowing fans to track its journey.

title: WDW 50 – Southwest Airlines Unveils Walt Disney World 50th Anniversary Plane
summary: Southwest Airlines and Walt Disney World Resort, both celebrating their 50th anniversaries in 2021, have collaborated to unveil a special co-branded Boeing 737-700 aircraft. This plane features commemorative logos and an EARidescent design, and will fly throughout the Southwest system until March 2022. The partnership also includes a "50 Days of Giveaways" sweepstakes offering Walt Disney World vacation packages and exclusive in-flight content for Southwest customers.

title: “Passion is contagious”: Kylie Watson-Wheeler, managing director of The Walt Disney Company, on staying curious
summary: Kylie Watson-Wheeler, managing director of The Walt Disney Company for Australia and New Zealand, shares insights into her career trajectory, emphasizing curiosity and embracing new opportunities. She discusses leading a female-majority team in a male-dominated industry and advises aspiring leaders to pursue their passions and maintain an open mind rather than focusing solely on climbing a linear career ladder.

title: Southwest and Disney unveil new livery celebrating joint 50th anniversaries
summary: Southwest Airlines and Walt Disney World Resort have collaborated on a new livery for a Boeing 737-700 aircraft, celebrating their respective 50th anniversaries. The design, symbolizing "50 Years of Memories and Magic," features Magic Kingdom and Walt Disney, with interior elements like character window shades and branded overhead bins. While the collaboration aims to enhance the travel experience for Disney fans, reviews from aviation and Disney enthusiasts have been mixed, with some finding the design underwhelming compared to previous special liveries.

title: JAKKS Pacific Launches New Toy Line This Week for Disney’s "Encanto"
summary: JAKKS Pacific, Inc. launched a new toy line for Disney's upcoming film "Encanto," featuring interactive playsets, dolls, and role-play items that embody the film's magic and music. The comprehensive global line will be available at retail starting October 3, aligning with the movie's theatrical release on November 24. This collection aims to allow children to re-enact their favorite film moments with characters and settings inspired by the story.

title: Comcast drops MSG's Rangers, Knicks games after saying almost no one watches them
summary: Comcast has dropped MSG Networks after their broadcast deal expired, removing access to Rangers and Knicks games for customers in New Jersey and Connecticut. Comcast cited extremely low viewership for MSG content and MSG's high financial demands as reasons for the decision, while MSG stated Comcast rejected proposals consistent with deals it has with other carriers. This dispute highlights a growing challenge for regional sports networks (RSNs) as pay-TV subscriptions decline and content costs rise, pushing carriers to re-evaluate carriage agreements.

title: Scarlett Johansson and Disney settle lawsuit over "Black Widow" release
summary: Scarlett Johansson and Walt Disney Co. have settled their lawsuit regarding the release of "Black Widow." Johansson had sued Disney, claiming the simultaneous streaming release of the film breached her contract and cost her potential earnings. Both parties expressed happiness with the resolution and their intention to continue working together.

title: A brief history of EPCOT: Walt Disney's failed city of tomorrow
summary: EPCOT, now a theme park, was originally conceived by Walt Disney as an Experimental Prototype Community of Tomorrow (EPCOT) – a fully functional "city of the future." Disney envisioned a circular city designed to overcome the frustrations of modern urban living, featuring advanced planning, monorail transportation, and where all residents would work for Disney. However, this utopian vision never materialized as Disney died before its development, leading his team to pivot to the theme park we know today.

title: Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, Disney Among Major Corporations Lying About Supporting Climate Action
summary: A new analysis by watchdog group Accountable.US reveals that major corporations like Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, and Disney are funding lobbying groups that actively work against significant climate legislation, despite publicly claiming to support climate action. These companies are reportedly supporting or directing organizations such as the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and Business Roundtable in their efforts to defeat the $3.5 trillion Build Back Better Act. This behavior is labeled as "greenwashing," where companies project an environmentally responsible image while undermining climate initiatives behind the scenes.

title: JAKKS Pacific Launches New Toy Line This Week for Disney’s “Encanto”
summary: JAKKS Pacific, Inc. announced the launch of its new toy line for Disney's upcoming film "Encanto," arriving in retail stores on October 3rd. The comprehensive collection includes interactive playsets, dolls, plush toys, and role-play dresses, featuring original movie scores and interactive elements. These toys are designed to bring the film's magical story and characters to life for children aged 3 and up.

title: Broadcast TV Advertising & Marketing | News Channel Ads
summary: TEGNA offers broadcast TV advertising solutions through its 64 local news brands in 51 markets, allowing advertisers to reach millions of households with award-winning local storytelling and original programming. The company emphasizes the benefits of local, live TV advertising for brand recall and introduces "Total TV," a comprehensive strategy combining broadcast and streaming to achieve stronger marketing outcomes. TEGNA highlights opportunities for content sponsorship, including alignment with major events like the Super Bowl and Olympics, and aims to connect brands with massive audiences.

title: JAKKS Pacific Introduces Disney Encanto Toys
summary: JAKKS Pacific has introduced a new toy line for Disney's upcoming film, Encanto, set to release on November 24. The collection includes a Magical Casa Madrigal playset, various Mirabel dolls, and character plush, all designed for ages 3 and up. JAKKS Pacific plans to release additional Encanto products next year following the initial launch.

title: Southwest Airlines unveils special co-branded commemorative Walt Disney World aircraft
summary: Southwest Airlines and Walt Disney World Resort are celebrating their 50th anniversaries with a special co-branded Boeing 737-700 aircraft, featuring 50th-anniversary logos and an EARidescent treatment. This collaboration includes a 'Southwest50 Days of Giveaways' sweepstakes and exclusive Walt Disney World content on Southwest's Inflight Entertainment Portal, connecting customers to magic through air travel. The aircraft will fly across the Southwest system until March 2022, offering guests a unique start to their Disney vacations.

title: Departing Hulu Chief Kelly Campbell in talks to join NBCUniversal
summary: Kelly Campbell, president of Hulu, has resigned from her position and is currently in negotiations to take a senior role at Comcast Corp.’s NBCUniversal. Campbell's departure comes after over four years at Hulu, with the last 21 months as president, and follows frustrations over restructurings that reduced her oversight in certain areas, including content. Her potential move to NBCUniversal suggests a significant shift in the streaming and media landscape.

title: Walt Disney Company to declare Q4 financial results two days prior to Disney+ Day
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced it will release its fiscal full year and fourth-quarter 2021 financial results on November 10, 2021, which will include updates on Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+ subscribers. CEO Bob Chapek indicated a potential slowdown in Disney+ subscriber growth for Q4. These results will be shared two days before Disney+ Day, an event celebrating the streaming service's second anniversary, featuring new content releases and its debut in South Korea, Taiwan, and Hong Kong.

title: A Conservative Fund Targets Investors Who Want To Avoid ‘Woke’ Companies
summary: An investment professional created the American Conservative Values ETF (ACVF) for investors seeking to avoid "woke" companies, boycotting those deemed hostile to conservative values. Despite boycotting 27 companies, the ETF has nearly matched the S&P 500's performance in its first 11 months. The fund is considering expanding into bond and international funds, as well as mid-cap and small-cap options.

title: More U.S. stock-market giants become available to Canadians in a low-cost version. Plus, why some investors may be underestimating the bull case for equities
summary: Canadian investors can now access fractional shares of major U.S. companies through Canadian depositary receipts (CDRs) offered by CIBC, providing a low-cost, currency-hedged investment option. These CDRs have seen strong interest, especially from DIY investors, despite slightly wider bid-ask spreads compared to their U.S. counterparts. The article also discusses reasons why investors might be underestimating the current bull case for equities, despite recent market wobbles due to inflation, bond yields, and other global concerns.

title: WildSmiles Partners with Disney on Themed Elastics
summary: WildSmiles Braces has collaborated with Disney to release a new collection of Disney-themed elastics, celebrating Walt Disney World’s 50th anniversary. This marks their second partnership, following a previous collection that included Mickey Mouse ear-shaped brackets. The new elastics feature characters like Woody, Jessie, Mr. and Mrs. Potato Head, Mickey, and Minnie, and are available in both latex and latex-free options in various sizes.

title: Shrek Sadness, Holiday Happiness, and Meeting the Mouse: Your Weekly Theme-Park Recap (October 4 - 10)
summary: This weekly theme-park recap covers significant updates from October 4-10, 2021. Highlights include the upcoming closure of Universal Studios Florida's Shrek 4D and a temporary closure for The Mummy attraction in early 2022. The article also announces the full return of holiday events and Mardi Gras at Universal, a new partnership between Universal Studios Japan and Pokémon, and the return of character meet and greets at Disney World.

title: Alan Horn to Retire as Chief Creative Officer, Disney Studios Content
summary: Alan Horn, Chief Creative Officer, Disney Studios Content, announced his retirement effective at the end of 2021. He had a nearly 50-year career in Hollywood, holding key leadership roles at Castle Rock Entertainment, Warner Bros., and The Walt Disney Studios. Under his leadership, Disney Studios achieved significant box office success and expanded its streaming content.

title: ClixTV Launches To Help Streamers Find Something To Watch
summary: ClixTV has launched as a new streaming service designed to help viewers find content across various top subscription services, offering its own short- and long-form programming, trailers, and e-commerce opportunities. Founded by industry veterans Edward Sullivan (CEO), Stacy Jolna (CMO), and Patricia Sullivan (CCO), ClixTV aims to simplify the content search experience for consumers and provide benefits for creators, distributors, and advertisers. The platform is available on multiple devices and services including Roku, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, and iOS/Android.

title: ZAG Bolsters Consumer Products Team
summary: ZAG, the animation studio behind "Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir," has expanded its consumer products team with a key promotion and two new hires. Lisa K. Foster has been promoted to Senior Vice President of Licensing, while Monique Daggett joins as Licensing Manager and Freddie Ordóñez as Licensing Attorney. These appointments support the ongoing retail expansion of the Miraculous franchise, targeting both young fans and young adults.

title: Star Wars Fans Can “Bring Home the Bounty” This Holiday Season With New Products Spanning the Galaxy
summary: Disney and Lucasfilm have launched "Bring Home the Bounty," a 12-week global campaign revealing new Star Wars products every Tuesday through December 28th, just in time for the holiday season. The campaign will feature items inspired by all eras of Star Wars, from the Skywalker Saga to new series like "The Mandalorian" and "The Book of Boba Fett," across various product categories. As part of the promotion, UPS will use specially wrapped vehicles resembling Jawa sandcrawlers in select New York City and Los Angeles metro areas, with a sweepstakes for fans to win Star Wars prize packs.

title: The Walt Disney Company Celebrates Disney+ Day on November 12
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced "Disney+ Day" on November 12, a global celebration marking the second anniversary of Disney+. The event will feature new content releases across Disney+, including movies like "Shang-Chi and The Legend of The Ten Rings" and "Jungle Cruise," new series, and shorts from its major brands, and will also involve promotions across Disney Parks, Resorts, and Cruise Line. Disney+ Day will also coincide with the service's expansion into new Asia-Pacific markets like South Korea, Taiwan, and Hong Kong.

title: The Walt Disney Company and NFL Reach Five Year Rights Agreement for ESPN to Present New Monday Night Wild Card Game Concluding Super Wild Card Weekend; Begins with Inaugural Game Following 2021 Regular Season
summary: The Walt Disney Company and the NFL have signed a five-year agreement for ESPN to broadcast a new Monday night Wild Card game, starting with the 2021 season. This game will conclude Super Wild Card Weekend and feature ESPN's MegaCast production across multiple platforms. Starting in 2023, ESPN will also add an NFL Divisional round game to its postseason coverage.

title: How ‘Squid Game’ reveals the flaw in Netflix’s products strategy
summary: Netflix's new partnership with Walmart for a digital storefront, the Netflix Hub, is criticized for its delayed inclusion of merchandise from the hugely popular show "Squid Game." While Netflix aims to diversify revenue through licensed products, the article highlights that fans are more interested in "real" items from the show, like Vans sneakers and tracksuits, which are experiencing massive sales spikes independently, revealing a flaw in Netflix's product strategy. The company's own official merchandise for "Squid Game" is described as limited and generic, not capitalizing on the immediate demand for authentic-looking items from the show.

title: Syracuse Mets to get Marvel superhero jerseys as part of new Minor League Baseball deal
summary: The Syracuse Mets and 95 other Minor League Baseball (MiLB) teams will partner with Marvel Entertainment for a three-year deal called “Marvel’s Defenders of the Diamond.” This partnership will bring superhero-themed games, special edition Marvel-branded jerseys, and a new comic book to stadiums during the 2022, 2023, and 2024 seasons. Syracuse Mets General Manager Jason Smorol expressed excitement about bringing more family fun to fans through this collaboration.

title: Disney+ partners with telecom operators for South Korea launch
summary: Walt Disney Co. is partnering with major South Korean telecom operators, KT and LG Uplus, to launch its Disney+ streaming service in South Korea on November 12th. This move is aimed at challenging Netflix's dominance in the market. Observers expect fierce competition between the two streaming giants, potentially increasing the overall penetration of over-the-top (OTT) services in the region.

title: Judge Temporarily Blocks United Airlines From Mandating Vaccines, While Pilots for Southwest Ask Courts To Do the Same
summary: A federal judge has issued a temporary restraining order against United Airlines, preventing the company from placing employees on unpaid leave who seek exemption from its COVID-19 vaccine mandate for religious or medical reasons. This ruling comes after six United employees filed a class action lawsuit arguing the airline failed to accommodate them. Meanwhile, pilots for Southwest Airlines have filed a similar lawsuit, seeking to block their company's vaccine mandate.

title: How Stephen Garden took Onica from class assignment to a multi-million dollar acquisition in just 6 years
summary: Stephen Garden transformed Onica from a class assignment at London Business School into a multi-million dollar acquisition by Rackspace in just six years by focusing on Amazon Web Services expertise. Despite Onica's rapid success and global reach, Garden stepped down from his SVP role at Rackspace in 2020 to prioritize personal well-being, taking a year-long sabbatical. The article highlights the intense dedication required for such entrepreneurial success and the importance of finding life balance.

title: Disney Imagineers see a world of new possibilities in giving customers what they want
summary: Disney Imagineers are focusing on guest immersion, advanced ride technology, and new intellectual properties to shape the future of their theme parks, aligning with Walt Disney's legacy of using innovation to enhance storytelling. They prioritize creating surprising, fresh experiences for visitors and believe in the importance of delivering stories that offer reassurance, wonder, and hope. This includes developing participatory attractions like the Space 220 restaurant and building new lands based on popular franchises like "Avatar" and "Star Wars."

title: Megahit "Squid Game" puts focus squarely on Netflix's overseas growth
summary: The success of "Squid Game" is prompting investors to focus on Netflix's international content strategy as a key driver for subscriber growth, especially in emerging markets, after a period of slowing additions. Analysts anticipate the megahit will boost subscriber numbers beyond estimates for the third quarter and impact the next three months. The article also highlights increased competition in the streaming market and Netflix's financial fundamentals.

title: ‘Squid Game’ frenzy lures new subscribers to Netflix
summary: Global interest in Netflix's Korean thriller "Squid Game" led to a significant increase in new subscribers, with the streaming giant adding 4.38 million subscribers in the third quarter of 2021, exceeding Wall Street estimates. This surge brought their worldwide total to 213.6 million viewers. The show's unexpected success helped overcome a slowdown in subscriber growth earlier in the year caused by pandemic-related production delays and increasing competition.

title: ‘Squid Game’ fuels Netflix profits and subscriber growth
summary: Netflix reported higher-than-expected quarterly profit and subscriber growth, largely driven by the global success of its South Korean series "Squid Game." The hit show garnered 142 million household views within its first four weeks, ranking first in 94 countries. This success validates Netflix's strategy of investing in foreign-language titles while the company also navigated controversy surrounding Dave Chappelle's comedy special.

title: From 'Stranger Things' to 'Squid Game,' here's how much money you'd have if you invested $1,000 in Netflix 10 years ago
summary: This article examines the impressive return on investment for Netflix over the past decade, driven by its growth in subscribers and original content. An initial investment of $1,000 in Netflix stock ten years ago would now be worth over $40,000, significantly outperforming the S&P 500. Despite recent controversies and challenges, Netflix continues to expand into new areas like video games and prioritize content creation.

title: Disguise announces new Disney costume rights in EMEA
summary: Disguise, a costume company, has secured a new multi-year licensing agreement with Disney for the EMEA region, expanding its costume offerings beyond North America for the first time. This agreement, beginning in spring 2022, will allow Disguise to produce a wide range of Disney character costumes and accessories for various celebrations like Book Week, Diwali, and Halloween, leveraging its parent company Jakks Pacific's expertise. The company plans to expand its EMEA team to support this growth and capitalize on Disney's extensive character catalog.

title: Disguise Secures Disney Costume License in EMEA
summary: Disguise, JAKKS Pacific’s costuming division, has expanded its licensing partnership with Disney to include Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This new multi-year agreement will allow Disguise to produce Disney-branded dress-up items, costumes, and accessories in these regions starting spring 2022. Disguise is also staffing a team of EMEA costume experts to support this expansion, aiming to maximize the category across various international holidays.

title: Disney Technology Lights Up the Screens at Virtual Grace Hopper Celebration of Women in Computing 2021
summary: The Walt Disney Company showcased its technology at the virtual 27th annual Grace Hopper Celebration of Women in Computing (GHC) in September 2021, connecting with thousands of attendees and potential recruits. Disney representatives from various business segments engaged in Q&A sessions, panels, and one-on-one conversations, highlighting the company as an innovative employer for women and nonbinary people in technology. The event served as a critical pipeline for diverse technical talent, with Disney extending employment offers for full-time and internship positions.

title: Seagate and Lucasfilm Collaborate to Take Gaming to the Next Level
summary: Seagate and Lucasfilm have collaborated to release a new family of Star Wars™ Beskar™ Ingot Drives, bringing designs inspired by the Star Wars franchise to PC gaming storage devices. These special edition drives, available in M.2 NVMe, 2.5-inch SATA, and external HDD formats, resemble a Beskar™ ingot and are intended to be a collectible for Star Wars fans. The drives offer various storage capacities and performance levels and will be available for the upcoming holiday season.

title: Universal Orlando reports "most profitable quarter in its history"
summary: Comcast announced that Universal Orlando had its "most profitable quarter in its history" for Q3 2021, driven by the recovery of its domestic theme parks and the success of its media platforms. Despite a lack of international guests, the theme park division's revenue increased significantly to $1.4 billion, reflecting improved operating conditions. The company also highlighted the successful opening of Universal Beijing Resort.

title: TAIT Acquires ITEC Entertainment
summary: TAIT, a global leader in live entertainment, has acquired ITEC Entertainment, an industry leader in entertainment design, technology, and project development. This acquisition combines two best-in-class organizations, leveraging their complementary expertise to become a comprehensive developer of entertainment projects and solutions. The move aims to achieve significant growth and enhance capabilities for clients, particularly in the theme park and attractions sector.

title: Iron Mountain’s Hollywood Treasures
summary: Iron Mountain Entertainment Services' Hollywood facility safeguards significant assets from theatrical and TV production history, including iconic props and celebrity documents. The company offers secure physical storage in an earthquake-resistant building, along with digital asset management, digitization, and media services, focusing on preserving older formats and leveraging cloud security for remote access. This comprehensive approach ensures the secure storage and accessibility of invaluable media and entertainment archives.

title: Marvel Studios’ ‘Eternals’ Sparks a Conversation About Accessible Films and Content
summary: Marvel Studios' "Eternals" has initiated significant conversations about making films and content accessible, particularly for the deaf and hard-of-hearing community. The film features the MCU's first deaf superhero, played by a deaf actor, and Disney implemented various initiatives like onscreen captions, ASL interpreters at premieres, and collaborations with disability-led nonprofits. These efforts have prompted exhibitors like AMC Theatres and Regal Cinemas to commit to expanded onscreen captioning for new releases globally, broadening access for diverse audiences.

title: Blackstone-backed firm nears $3 billion deal for Moonbug Entertainment - sources
summary: A Blackstone-backed company, co-led by former Walt Disney Co executives Kevin Mayer and Tom Staggs, is reportedly close to acquiring Moonbug Entertainment for approximately $3 billion. The deal for the creator of popular children's shows like "CoComelon" and "Little Baby Bum" includes an upfront payment of $2.75 billion and an additional $300 million based on performance. This acquisition aligns with Mayer and Staggs' strategy for their new media company, leveraging Moonbug's popular characters for licensing and merchandising.

title: Israeli firm Beamr awarded Emmy for video compression tech
summary: The Israeli company Beamr received an Emmy in the Technology & Engineering category from the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences for its patented video compression technology. This technology reduces video file sizes while maintaining high quality, benefiting streaming services and broadcasters. Beamr's solution uses a quality measure called BQM to adjust bitrate automatically, saving bandwidth and improving efficiency for major clients like Netflix and Microsoft.

title: Adobe Joins Forces with Disney to Advance Digital Literacy
summary: Adobe has partnered with The Walt Disney Company for the Adobe Analytics Challenge 2021, where college students will analyze Disney's e-commerce strategy to develop actionable insights for customer loyalty and online sales. This global competition provides students with real-world experience in digital data analytics, utilizing Adobe Analytics to solve pressing business challenges for a major brand. The initiative also includes the Adobe Analytics curriculum for higher education, providing free access to the software and course materials to foster digital literacy.

title: Disney Accelerator Showcases Eight Companies at 2021 Demo Day
summary: The Walt Disney Company concluded its 2021 Disney Accelerator program by showcasing eight companies at its Demo Day. These companies presented their innovative technologies in areas like robotics, personalization, e-commerce, and AI, with many already piloting projects or in discussions with various Disney business units. The program aimed to connect selected global companies with Disney's expertise and leadership, fostering new consumer experiences.

title: The new Netflix series ‘Arcane’ expands ‘League of Legends’ into entertainment
summary: Riot Games is launching "Arcane," a TV series based on "League of Legends," on Netflix, leveraging its massive in-game ecosystem to promote the show. This initiative aims to expand the "League of Legends" universe into a multimedia franchise, akin to Disney and Marvel, with integrated experiences across its games and coinciding with the Riot League World Finals. Riot Games CEO Nicolo Laurent emphasizes that this integrated experience is primarily for the players, further solidifying the company's ambition to become a major entertainment player.

title: Disney Plus is upgrading Marvel movies to IMAX aspect ratio
summary: Disney and IMAX have announced a collaboration to bring IMAX's Expanded Aspect Ratio format to several Marvel movies on Disney Plus. Starting November 12th, 13 MCU titles, including Shang-Chi, will feature specific scenes in the 1.90:1 aspect ratio, reducing black bars on 16:9 TVs. This upgrade, part of the IMAX Enhanced program, will eventually also include DTS surround sound.

title: Marvel Studios’ ‘Eternals’ Opens with $161.7 Million Worldwide
summary: Marvel Studios' "Eternals" achieved a strong global box office debut, opening at No. 1 in all key markets with an estimated $161.7 million worldwide over its initial weekend. The film earned $71.0 million domestically and $90.7 million internationally, setting pandemic-era opening records in several countries. This performance contributes to Marvel Cinematic Universe films holding three of the top four pandemic-era opening weekends.

title: TOTY Awards Unveil 2022 Finalists
summary: The 2022 Toy of the Year (TOTY) Awards announced 114 finalists across 16 categories, including a new 'Grown-Up Toy of the Year' award. Consumers can vote for their favorites until January 4, 2022, with winners to be revealed at a New York City gala on February 18, 2022, kicking off Toy Fair New York. Proceeds from the gala will benefit The Toy Foundation, supporting children in need.

title: Disney+ has Shang-Chi, and 12 other Marvel movies in large IMAX format
summary: Disney+ has partnered with IMAX to offer 13 Marvel movies in the IMAX Expanded Aspect Ratio (1.90:1) starting November 12, 2021. This format makes the picture appear up to 26% taller than standard widescreen. Titles include "Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings" and other popular MCU films, with future plans for DTS surround sound and more IMAX Enhanced content.

title: IMAX Enhanced to Launch on Disney+
summary: The Walt Disney Company and DTS announced that IMAX Enhanced will launch on Disney+ starting November 12th, allowing subscribers to stream 13 Marvel titles in IMAX's expanded aspect ratio. This feature provides up to 26% more picture for select sequences, and future collaborations promise enhanced audio and visual technology, including IMAX signature sound by DTS. The launch is part of the Disney+ Day global celebration and includes the Disney+ premiere of "Shang-Chi and The Legend of The Ten Rings," alongside other popular MCU movies.

title: Color Intelligence Launches Look Designer 2 For Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects
summary: Color Intelligence has launched Look Designer 2 for Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, extending its high-end color grading and film emulation tools to a broader creative community. This software, previously exclusive to DaVinci Resolve, aims to democratize advanced look development capabilities typically reserved for high-budget productions. Look Designer 2 offers intuitive workflows, efficient color management, and the ability to emulate analog film aesthetics, allowing creators to produce unique cinematic looks directly within Adobe applications.

title: More people are visiting SeaWorld, latest earnings call reveals
summary: SeaWorld's latest earnings report shows significant gains in attendance and revenue, with the company nearing a record-breaking financial quarter despite ongoing challenges from the pandemic and unfavorable weather. CEO Marc Swanson attributed the success to factors like ticket pricing and strong appeal to day-trippers, alongside the return of special events which are boosting all Orlando theme parks. SeaWorld plans to introduce new rides and attractions next year to continue this growth.

title: 6 Reasons Why You Should Watch the MCU in IMAX’s Expanded Aspect Ratio
summary: Starting November 12, select Marvel Cinematic Universe titles will be available on Disney+ with IMAX’s Expanded Aspect Ratio (1:90:1), offering up to 26% more picture for certain sequences. This enhancement allows viewers to experience the films closer to the filmmakers' original theatrical intent, revealing new details and providing a more immersive visual experience at home. Bruce Markoe, SVP of Post Production/Operations and DMR at IMAX, highlights that this format makes action sequences and characters, especially Ant-Man, feel "larger than life."

title: IMAX Enhanced will finally stream Avengers: Endgame 'as the filmmakers intended' (exclusive)
summary: Disney+ is launching IMAX Enhanced on November 12, allowing subscribers to stream 13 Marvel Cinematic Universe movies, including "Avengers: Endgame" and "Avengers: Infinity War," in the original IMAX aspect ratio of 1.90:1. This feature eliminates black bars, offering 26% more picture and enhanced sound to provide the viewing experience intended by the filmmakers. While initially limited to Marvel titles, there are plans to expand the IMAX Enhanced library in the future.

title: Celebrate The Holidays With Build-A-Bear Workshop® And Find The Perfect Personalized Gift For Everyone On Your List
summary: Build-A-Bear Workshop is highlighting its holiday offerings, including personalized "gifts with heart" available in-store and online at buildabear.com. The brand is introducing new Merry Mission friends, various gifts for family members, an updated Honey Girls collection, and Harry Potter™ themed items. Additionally, Build-A-Bear has partnered with Klarna to offer flexible payment options and donate 10,000 bears to Toys for Tots, and is showcasing new apparel collections with Tipsy Elves and Rockets of Awesome, alongside Star Wars™ merchandise.

title: A whole new world: Disney is latest firm to announce metaverse plans
summary: Disney has announced its plans to enter the metaverse, following in the footsteps of tech giants like Mark Zuckerberg's Meta and Microsoft. The company aims to connect physical and digital worlds to enhance storytelling, with CEO Bob Chapek envisioning a "three-dimensional canvas" for content on Disney+. This move positions Disney alongside other companies exploring virtual realities, despite some of its past digital ventures experiencing struggles.

title: Second Sesame Place Park Reaches Construction Milestone on Sesame Street Day as the March 2022 Grand Opening Approaches
summary: SeaWorld Parks & Entertainment and Sesame Workshop announced that the second Sesame Place park, Sesame Place San Diego, is nearing completion with a grand opening slated for March 2022. The 17-acre park will feature various Sesame Street-themed attractions, rides, and interactive experiences, including a 500,000-gallon wave pool for summer. The park will also open as a Certified Autism Center, providing resources and accommodations for guests with autism.

title: Shang-Chi, Black Widow and 11 More Marvel Studios Films Available on Disney+ in IMAX's Expanded Aspect Ratio
summary: Thirteen Marvel Studios films are now available on Disney+ in IMAX's Expanded Aspect Ratio, offering up to 26% more picture for select sequences. This collaboration, starting on Disney+ Day, provides an enhanced home viewing experience, with future plans to include immersive IMAX signature sound by DTS. Disney+ is the first major streaming service to elevate at-home viewing with IMAX Enhanced technology, allowing subscribers to re-experience the Marvel Cinematic Universe with greater visual fidelity.

title: Disney General Entertainment Content and Disney Television Studios Unveil the Infinity on Disney Stage 1
summary: Disney General Entertainment Content and Disney Television Studios have partnered with Industrial Light & Magic (ILM) to transform the historic Stage 1 on the Disney Lot into "The Infinity on Disney Stage 1," a state-of-the-art virtual production facility. This initiative brings ILM's StageCraft technology to episodic television production, allowing for game-changing creative possibilities and efficiency. The stage has already been utilized for the Hulu Original series "How I Met Your Father," demonstrating its potential for creating complex scenes without the logistical challenges of on-location shoots.

title: Disney General Entertainment Content and Disney Television Studios Unveil the Infinity on Disney Stage 1
summary: Disney General Entertainment Content and Disney Television Studios have partnered with Industrial Light & Magic (ILM) to transform the historic Stage 1 on the Disney Lot into "The Infinity on Disney Stage 1," a state-of-the-art virtual production facility using ILM’s StageCraft toolset. This initiative brings groundbreaking virtual production technology, previously common in feature films, to episodic television production. The new stage, composed of 700 LED panels creating a 1,600 square foot canvas, is already being used for TV productions like the Hulu Original series "How I Met Your Father," demonstrating its ability to create complex scenes efficiently and cost-effectively.

title: “Taxes Destroy Value”: Why AT&T Is Using a Reverse Morris Trust in the WarnerMedia-Discovery Deal
summary: AT&T is utilizing a rare financial structure called a Reverse Morris Trust for its spin-off of WarnerMedia and subsequent merger with Discovery. This method, historically used by tax-averse media mogul John Malone, allows the deal to be tax-free for the seller (AT&T) and its shareholders. The structure ensures AT&T shareholders retain a majority interest (71%) in the new Warner Bros. Discovery to meet IRS requirements for tax-free status, despite Discovery executives leading the combined entity.

title: Netflix releases weekly list of top shows by viewing hours
summary: Netflix has begun releasing weekly reports of its top shows and movies by viewing hours globally, a move towards greater transparency in streaming viewership data. This new system breaks out top 10 lists for English and non-English titles, with "Squid Game" dominating non-English TV and "Red Notice" leading English-language films recently. The initiative addresses past criticisms of streamers for selectively sharing data and aims to provide a clearer understanding of success in the streaming world.

title: Beyblade Burst QuadDrive Teases New Battle Set
summary: Hasbro is expanding its Beyblade Burst toy line with the new QuadDrive Cosmic Vector Battle Set, coinciding with the premiere of the Beyblade Burst QuadDrive series on Disney XD and DisneyNOW in December 2021. The new series introduces "four-in-one tops" and new characters, while the Beyblade brand celebrates its 20th anniversary with influencer collaborations.

title: Sherwin-Williams Celebrates The Magic Of Color With Walt Disney Animation Studios' "Encanto"
summary: Sherwin-Williams has partnered with Walt Disney Animation Studios to celebrate the upcoming film "Encanto" by creating curated color palettes inspired by the movie and its characters. The collaboration includes a character-based personality quiz, a look behind the scenes at the color design, and the availability of these new colors in Sherwin-Williams stores and through their ColorSnap® Visualizer app.

summary: This article identifies 13 companies with strong economic moats but poor capital allocation ratings according to Morningstar's criteria. summary: Target reported strong third-quarter earnings, exceeding expectations with robust growth across all five core categories, leading the company to raise its fourth-quarter holiday guidance. CEO Brian Cornell acknowledged these challenges, emphasizing the company's agility in addressing them and its long-term investment in meeting customer demand.

summary: fuboTV's stock crashed over 25% after its third-quarter earnings report, despite impressive revenue growth, due to significant operating losses and shareholder dilution. title: Here's a Simple Reason Why Magnite Stock Can Keep Winning
summary: Magnite is poised for continued success due to its strong market position in the connected-TV (CTV) ad space, particularly by having major players like Disney's Hulu and Roku as customers. summary: This article details how Marvel Studios’ *Hawkeye* was intentionally set during the Christmas season to introduce a fresh, grounded narrative contrasting the usual world-ending stakes in the MCU. summary: Major brands like Chipotle, Vans, and Verizon are increasingly engaging with metaverse-like platforms such as Roblox and Fortnite Creative. summary: Comcast and The Walt Disney Co. have reached a new carriage agreement, averting a potential disruption in content distribution. summary: Cruise lines have updated their policies since resuming U.S. cruises in June, implementing vaccine and testing requirements to prevent Covid-19 outbreaks and disruptions. summary: An Amazon Web Services (AWS) outage on Tuesday affected various websites and services, including Disney+, Netflix, and Coinbase, as well as critical internal Amazon tools like its Flex and AtoZ apps. The contentious lawsuit, marked by personal animosity and accusations, ultimately concluded with a $441 million settlement for Rad and his co-plaintiffs, highlighting the emotional and financial stakes involved in the tech industry's ownership disputes.

title: Experience Chloé Zhao's Full Vision For 'Eternals' at Home with IMAX
summary: Marvel Studios' "Eternals," directed by Chloé Zhao, is now streaming on Disney+ with IMAX's Expanded Aspect Ratio, allowing viewers to experience the film closer to the filmmaker's original vision. The article highlights how IMAX's technology enhances the storytelling, particularly showcasing the vast scale of the Celestials and the immersive quality of select scenes. Bruce Markoe of IMAX and Evan Jacobs of Marvel Studios explain the technical adaptations made for home viewing while preserving Zhao's artistic intent.

title: Netflix raises monthly subscription prices in U.S., Canada
summary: Netflix has increased its monthly subscription prices in the U.S. and Canada by $1 to $2, depending on the plan, to fund new programming and maintain competitiveness in the streaming market. The standard U.S. plan now costs $15.49, up from $13.99, while the Canadian standard plan rose to C$16.49 from C$14.99. These increases, the first since October 2020 in these markets, reflect Netflix's pricing power as it faces growing competition from other major streaming services.

title: Here’s How Warren Buffett Persuaded Google’s Reluctant Founders to Go Public
summary: Google co-founders Sergey Brin and Larry Page were initially hesitant to take their company public due to fears of losing control. A serendipitous meeting with Warren Buffett, who shared his strategy of a two-tier stock structure used at Berkshire Hathaway, convinced them that they could go public while retaining control. This led Google to adopt a similar stock structure for its IPO and publish an "Owner's Manual" outlining their long-term philosophy for shareholders.

title: Disney+ Debuts Trailer and Poster for Marvel Studios’ ‘Moon Knight’
summary: Disney+ has released a new trailer and poster for Marvel Studios’ upcoming series, 'Moon Knight,' which is set to premiere on March 30. The series follows Steven Grant, a mild-mannered employee who discovers he shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector due to dissociative identity disorder, leading them into a dangerous mystery involving Egyptian gods. Oscar Isaac, Ethan Hawke, and May Calamawy star, with Jeremy Slater as head writer and Kevin Feige among the executive producers.

title: Netflix earnings to set the pace for 2022 streaming wars
summary: Netflix is set to report its fourth-quarter earnings this week, which will provide insight into the growth of streaming services in 2022. The company, along with competitors like Disney and Amazon, is investing heavily in new content amid intensifying "streaming wars." Analysts expect Netflix's growth to stabilize in 2022, primarily driven by international markets, as competition for subscribers increases, especially in the U.S.

title: The Walt Disney Company Promotes a Handful of Executives to New Positions to Support the Newly Created International Content Group
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced promotions for several executives to bolster its direct-to-consumer business and international content creation. Rebecca Campbell will lead the newly formed International Content Group as Chairman, focusing on localized content for Disney's streaming services. Additionally, Michael Paull is now President of Disney Streaming, overseeing Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, and Star+ globally, with Joe Earley appointed as President of Hulu.

title: Disney CEO Bob Chapek's pay doubles to $32.5 million as cash bonuses return to the Mouse House
summary: Walt Disney Co. CEO Bob Chapek's compensation doubled to $32.5 million in fiscal year 2021, driven by a return of cash bonuses for executives as the company recovered from the pandemic. This package included a $14.3 million bonus, a $2.5 million salary, and significant stock awards and options. Former executive chairman Bob Iger also saw substantial compensation, earning $45.9 million in the same period for his creative oversight.

title: The Walt Disney Company Creates International Content Group To Expand Pipeline Of Local Content And Continue To Grow Its Global Direct-To-Consumer Business
summary: The Walt Disney Company is establishing a new international content group to expand its pipeline of local content for its streaming services, under the leadership of Rebecca Campbell as Chairman, International Content and Operations. This move supports the company's direct-to-consumer business growth, with key executive appointments including Michael Paull as President, Disney Streaming, overseeing Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, and Star+, and Joe Earley as President of Hulu. The restructuring aims to enhance localized content strategy and global streaming innovation.

title: Netflix misses subscriber target, shares fall on weak forecast
summary: Netflix Inc fell short of analyst predictions for new subscribers in the fourth quarter of last year, adding 8.3 million customers against a projected 8.4 million. This, along with a weaker forecast for early 2022 due to increased competition, caused its shares to drop by 10 percent in after-hours trading. The company's global subscriber count reached 221.8 million, and it is now focusing on overseas growth after raising prices in the US and Canada.

title: Hudi powering data lake efforts at Walmart and Disney+ Hotstar
summary: Apache Hudi, an open-source data lake platform, is gaining significant adoption among large enterprises like Uber, Walmart, and Disney+ Hotstar. The article highlights how these companies are leveraging Hudi for scalable data management, improved performance, and efficient analytics, addressing challenges previously faced with other data management systems. Walmart and Disney+ Hotstar specifically detail their migration to Hudi and its benefits, while Uber continues to utilize and contribute to the project.

title: Netflix stock drops after streaming giant predicts subscriber slowdown. (Published 2022)
summary: Netflix's stock dropped nearly 20 percent after the company announced it added 8.3 million subscribers in Q4 but forecast only 2.5 million additions for the current quarter. This projection signals one of the slowest growth periods for the streaming giant in years, despite strong performance in the U.S. and Canada. Co-chief executive Reed Hastings expressed frustration, attributing the slowdown potentially to COVID-19 effects or increased competition from services like Disney+ and HBO Max.

title: Netflix tanks again as investors question growth prospects
summary: Netflix shares continued to fall after the company announced a significant slowdown in subscriber growth, missing analyst forecasts and marking its slowest annual growth pace since 2016. Despite these challenges, some Wall Street analysts remain optimistic, viewing the subscriber shortfall as a forecasting issue rather than an existential threat, particularly given Netflix's strong international expansion prospects.

title: The Walt Disney Company Announces New Leadership Roles for Trisha Husson, Eric Marcotte with Disney General Entertainment
summary: The Walt Disney Company has announced new leadership roles within its Disney General Entertainment (DGE) division. Trisha Husson has been named head of Strategy, Business Operations and Finance for DGE, overseeing financial planning, content analytics, and other strategic functions. Eric Marcotte will take on Husson's previous role as senior vice president overseeing the Strategy & Business Operations team for DGE.

title: Liberty Media Is World’s Largest Sports Empire
summary: Liberty Media leads as the world's largest sports empire, valued at $17.2 billion, significantly outpacing its competitors. The sports empire landscape is expanding, with the top 20 empires now collectively worth $124 billion, a 22% increase from the previous year. This growth is fueled by major media deals for leagues like the NFL and NHL, alongside a trend of multi-team ownership, especially in soccer, as investors seek more diverse portfolios.

title: For Netflix stock, it's like the pandemic never happened
summary: Netflix shares have fallen to their lowest level since April 2020, erasing gains made during the pandemic, due to concerns over subscriber growth. The company reported a much lower subscriber forecast for the first quarter, spooking investors and raising concerns for other media companies that have transitioned to streaming. This decline signals a potential revaluation for streaming competitors as well.

title: Abigail Disney Directing New Movie Criticizing Treatment of Cast Members
summary: Abigail Disney, granddaughter of Disney co-founder Roy O. Disney, has co-directed a new film, "The American Dream and Other Fairy Tales," which critically examines economic inequality in the U.S. and Disney's treatment of its cast members. The film highlights the disparity between executive compensation and cast member wages, with Disneyland and Walt Disney World cast members earning significantly less per hour than the combined $80 million earned by CEOs Bob Chapek and Bob Iger last year. While Disney has not yet secured a distributor, the film aims to spark a conversation about a more equitable future.

title: Electronic Arts and Lucasfilm Games Announce New Star Wars Titles in Development From Respawn Entertainment
summary: Electronic Arts and Lucasfilm Games have announced an expanded collaboration to develop three new Star Wars titles through Respawn Entertainment. These include the next game in the Star Wars Jedi franchise, a new Star Wars first-person shooter led by Peter Hirschmann, and a Star Wars strategy game developed in partnership with Bit Reactor. Vince Zampella of Respawn will oversee these projects, and work has already begun on all three.

title: Electronic Arts and Lucasfilm Games Announce New Star Wars Titles in Development From Respawn Entertainment
summary: Electronic Arts and Lucasfilm Games announced the development of three new Star Wars titles by Respawn Entertainment: the next game in the Star Wars Jedi franchise, a new Star Wars first-person shooter directed by Peter Hirschmann, and a Star Wars strategy game in collaboration with Bit Reactor. Vince Zampella of Respawn will oversee these projects, emphasizing Respawn's history in game development and storytelling within the Star Wars universe. Work has already begun on all three games, and Respawn is actively seeking new talent.

title: Mattel Rises After Winning Back Disney Princess Toys From Hasbro
summary: Mattel Inc. shares jumped after the company announced it won back the global licensing agreement to produce toys based on Walt Disney Co.’s princesses and the "Frozen" movies. This marks a significant comeback for Mattel, which lost these rights to Hasbro Inc. in 2016. The new toy collection is expected to be available for sale at the beginning of 2023.

title: Mattel wins back Disney Princess toys from Hasbro
summary: Mattel has reacquired the licensing rights for Disney Princess toys from Hasbro. This move signifies a notable shift in the competitive landscape of the toy industry, with Mattel regaining a valuable franchise.

title: Mattel Wins Back Disney Princess and ‘Frozen’ Toys Licensing Deal From Hasbro
summary: Mattel has reacquired the licensing rights for Disney Princess and 'Frozen' toys from Hasbro, a deal it lost in 2016. This multiyear global pact allows Mattel to produce a new line of dolls and figures for early 2023, building on their existing relationship with Disney for Pixar franchises. The news led to a 6.63% increase in Mattel's stock during pre-market trading.

title: Hasbro Expands Relationship With Disney’s Lucasfilm, Extending Star Wars License and Adding New Deal for Indiana Jones Franchise
summary: Hasbro has announced an extended relationship with Lucasfilm, renewing its Star Wars licensing deal and securing a new agreement for the Indiana Jones franchise. As a master toy licensee, Hasbro will continue to create toys and games for Star Wars and will develop a new line of Indiana Jones products available in 2023, coinciding with the new feature film release. This expansion further strengthens Hasbro's longstanding partnership with Disney, which also includes a multi-year extension for Marvel products.

title: Mattel Stock Soars After Regaining License to Make ‘Frozen,’ Disney Princess Toys
summary: Mattel's stock surged after the company announced it had regained the global licensing rights to produce toys based on Walt Disney's Princess and Frozen franchises, lines it previously lost to Hasbro in 2016. The new agreement expands on Mattel's existing relationship with Disney for other properties like Toy Story and Cars, with new products expected in 2023. Meanwhile, rival Hasbro also had positive news, renewing its Star Wars licensing deal and securing rights for Indiana Jones toys.

title: Netflix: Why the world's biggest streaming service is frustrated with India
summary: Netflix, despite its global success, is struggling to gain significant traction in the competitive Indian streaming market. With 5.5 million subscribers, it lags far behind rivals like Disney+ Hotstar and Amazon Prime Video, which have focused on local content, sports, and bundled services. Experts suggest Netflix needs to localize its content more deeply and move beyond its "international playbook" to attract a wider Indian audience.

title: Genius Brands Promotes Industry Leader Kerry Phelan to Chief Brand Officer
summary: Genius Brands International, Inc. (Nasdaq: GNUS) has promoted Kerry Phelan to the newly created position of Chief Brand Officer. This move follows the company's significant expansion, including acquisitions of WOW! Unlimited Media, Inc. and Ameba TV, and a major investment in Your Family Entertainment. Phelan, who has a distinguished 30-year career in consumer products and retail with major studios, will now spearhead global brand strategy, consumer products, and partnerships for Genius Brands' growing portfolio of children's properties.

title: Wall Street gains evaporate, S&P 500 ends lower on Fed tightening timeline
summary: The S&P 500 ended lower after the U.S. Federal Reserve indicated it would soon raise interest rates to combat persistent inflation. All three major U.S. stock indexes swung wildly, with the Dow and S&P 500 closing in negative territory, while Nasdaq saw a nominal gain. The market reacted strongly to Fed Chair Jerome Powell's comments about inflation and supply problems being more severe and long-lasting than anticipated.

title: Universal Studios Orlando Leads NBCU Theme Parks, Epic Universe Next
summary: NBCUniversal's theme parks had their most profitable fourth quarter ever, driven by strong performance at Universal Studios Orlando, Hollywood, and Japan. Despite some limitations from COVID-19, especially in Beijing, the division saw significant revenue and EBITDA growth. Construction on the new Epic Universe theme park in Orlando is progressing rapidly, with an opening planned by summer 2025, representing Comcast/NBCUniversal's largest theme park investment to date.

title: Reddit 'antiwork' forum implodes, goes private after train wreck interview with Fox News
summary: The popular Reddit forum /r/Antiwork went private after a moderator, Doreen Ford, gave a widely criticized interview to Fox News's Jesse Watters. The interview, where Ford appeared disheveled and stated "laziness is a virtue," caused an internet backlash and led to accusations from users of misrepresenting the subreddit's goals. Consequently, Ford was removed from her moderation duties, and many users migrated to a new subreddit, /r/WorkReform.

title: Revolving Door Roundup: Havas Media Group, Joan, Shadow and More
summary: This article summarizes recent noteworthy developments in the advertising and marketing agency world. It details new partnerships, rebrands, and agency launches, including Havas Media Group becoming Edgewell's media agency of record, Joan being selected by S&P Global, and Dolphin Entertainment creating a new Web3-focused agency. The roundup also highlights marketing campaigns featuring celebrity endorsements and innovative technological activations.

title: Disney Names Former J.P. Morgan Analyst Alexia Quadrani As Head Of Investor Relations
summary: The Walt Disney Co. has appointed Alexia Quadrani, a former J.P. Morgan media analyst, as its new head of investor relations. She replaces Lowell Singer and will report directly to CFO Christine McCarthy. Quadrani will be the company's liaison with Wall Street, managing relationships with analysts and investors, and advising senior management on financial matters.

title: Univision cerró acuerdo con Televisa para una nueva plataforma de streaming
summary: Univision and Televisa have finalized a $4.8 billion merger, creating a new Spanish-language media giant called TelevisaUnivision Inc. This agreement paves the way for a new streaming service, which will feature both free and premium tiers with a wide range of entertainment, sports, and news content. Despite growing competition in the streaming market, Univision aims to leverage its extensive programming library and vast network of broadcast and cable channels to promote the new platform.

title: AT&T opts for WarnerMedia spinoff in Discovery merger, cuts dividend
summary: AT&T announced it will spin off WarnerMedia in a $43 billion transaction to merge its media properties with Discovery Inc., and subsequently cut its dividend by nearly half. AT&T shareholders will own 71% of the new Warner Bros. Discovery company and receive 0.24 shares for each AT&T share. The move aims to reduce AT&T's debt and positions the new entity, Warner Bros Discovery, to compete in the streaming market against rivals like Netflix.

title: Televisa y Univision se fusionan para lanzar nueva empresa de streaming y competir con Netflix
summary: Televisa and Univision have merged to create TelevisaUnivision, Inc., a new streaming company aimed at becoming the dominant Spanish-language content producer globally. This new venture seeks to compete with major streaming platforms like Netflix and Amazon Prime Video by targeting the "underserved" Hispanic digital market. The new company, with Televisa as the majority shareholder, will offer a vast catalog of content from both media giants, including a free and premium subscription model, expected to launch in 2022.

title: Disney Ranks High on Fortune’s 2022 List of “World’s Most Admired Companies”
summary: The Walt Disney Company has been recognized on Fortune's 2022 list of "World's Most Admired Companies," ranking No. 5 overall and retaining its position as the top-ranked media and entertainment company for the 19th consecutive year. Disney received high marks across various areas including innovation, quality of management, financial soundness, and social responsibility. The list was compiled by Fortune in partnership with Korn Ferry, surveying executives, directors, and analysts.

title: PHOTOS: Columbia Sportswear "Star Wars: Boba Fett Collection" Apparel Lands at Disney Springs
summary: The new Columbia Sportswear "Star Wars: Boba Fett Collection" apparel is now available at Disney Springs. This collection includes a women’s jacket for $450, men’s graphic tees in white and black for $50 each, and a men’s hoodie for $120. The merchandise can be found at the Columbia Sportswear store, capitalizing on the recent focus on Boba Fett in Star Wars content.

title: My first stock: Arlene Dickinson on investing in IBM
summary: Arlene Dickinson recounts her first stock purchase of IBM in 1983 with $500, an experience that caused significant stress and led her to sell the stock quickly. This initial investment taught her valuable lessons about market volatility, the importance of understanding what you invest in, and the necessity of not investing more than one can afford to lose. These lessons shaped her long-term investing style, emphasizing diversification and calculated risks with blue-chip stocks.

title: Want Exposure To Google? 2 Communication Services ETFs Holding Alphabet Shares
