summary: Disney exceeded Wall Street's expectations for its fiscal second quarter, largely driven by its direct-to-consumer streaming segment, which achieved profitability ahead of schedule. The company reported increased revenue and diluted earnings per share, with both Disney+ and Hulu contributing to subscriber growth and improved financial performance. Disney remains on track to achieve overall streaming profitability by the fiscal fourth quarter, a long-standing goal since the launch of its streaming services.

title: 3 things we learned from Disney's latest earnings report
summary: Disney's latest earnings report revealed a surprise profit in its streaming division, with Disney+ and Hulu collectively posting $47 million in profit. The company plans to integrate more sports content from ESPN+ into Disney+ to boost engagement. Additionally, global theme parks are performing well, with revenue increases attributed to higher ticket prices and new attractions, effectively offsetting increased operating costs.

title: Marvel Studios and ILM Immersive Announce 'What If…? – An Immersive Story,' Coming Exclusively to Apple Vision Pro
summary: Marvel Studios and ILM Immersive are launching 'What If…? – An Immersive Story' exclusively on Apple Vision Pro on May 30. This interactive Disney+ Original experience allows fans to step into the Multiverse in mixed reality, becoming participants in an all-new narrative connected to the acclaimed animated series. It leverages Apple Vision Pro's spatial computing to offer a technologically advanced adventure, where users interact with environments and characters using their eyes and hands, exploring new and iconic MCU locations.

title: Lumen Technologies names former Sabre CLO as next legal head
summary: Lumen Technologies has appointed Chad Ho, formerly the Chief Legal Officer at Sabre Corporation, as its new legal head. He will replace Stacey Goff, who is departing after 26 years with Lumen and its predecessors. Ho brings extensive experience in advising publicly-traded and high-growth technology companies and will oversee all legal matters for Lumen.

title: Netflix’s head of design answers every question you ever had about Netflix
summary: In a rare and extended Q&A, Netflix's VP of Design, Steve Johnson, discusses the company's design philosophy, its approach to gaming, the Vision Pro, and generative AI. Despite Netflix's 260 million subscribers and its leading position in the streaming industry, Johnson explains the ongoing challenge of helping users discover what they want to watch. He also shares insights into how the streaming giant designs its system and navigates the crowded entertainment landscape.

title: Rita Ferro, Disney’s President of Global Advertising, on the Company’s Upfront and the Differentiator of Storytelling
summary: Rita Ferro, Disney's President of Global Advertising, discusses the company's upcoming Upfront presentation, highlighting Disney's unique position in advertising through its strong storytelling, iconic brands, and advanced technology. She emphasizes Disney's scale across entertainment and sports, its focus on growth in sports and streaming, and the importance of integrating advertising within its diverse content portfolio to drive impact for advertisers. Ferro reiterates that Disney is both a technology and a storytelling company, with creativity being a key differentiator.

title: Walt Disney World Makes History with Victoria & Albert’s MICHELIN Star
summary: Victoria & Albert’s at Disney’s Grand Floridian Resort & Spa has received a MICHELIN Star, becoming the first restaurant owned and operated by a U.S. theme park to earn this prestigious award. Chef de Cuisine Matthew Sowers and Maître d’Hôtel Israel Pérez highlight the restaurant's commitment to high-quality ingredients, exceptional service, and creating unforgettable dining experiences, defying the perception that fine cuisine is exclusive to major metropolitan cities. The team aims to continue innovating and hopes to earn a second MICHELIN Star, always focused on transporting guests away from their daily lives.

title: As Gorin debuts as CEO, Expedia Group launches new AI assistant, content creator shops
summary: As Ariane Gorin steps in as CEO, Expedia Group has launched new products, including "Romie," an AI travel assistant, and "Travel Shops" for content creators. These initiatives leverage generative AI to enhance the traveler experience through personalized recommendations and new opportunities for influencers to monetize their travel content. The company also announced additional AI updates for travelers and partners and a new in-house media network.

title: Epic Universe will ‘redefine the park experience,’ Comcast CEO says
summary: Comcast CEO Brian Roberts claims that the new Epic Universe theme park in Orlando will "redefine the park experience" and revolutionize the industry. The park, set to open next year, will utilize advanced technology beyond just rides, including facial recognition and innovative solutions for navigation, payments, and retail. With new hotels and five distinct lands, Universal Orlando aims to attract more visitors and compete with Disney World, positioning Epic Universe as a significant investment for the company.

title: Gap Inc. selects Omnicom as media AOR, reorganizes key media functions
summary: Gap Inc. has appointed Omnicom Media Group (OMG) as its new cross-brand media agency of record, aiming to modernize its media model and enhance brand revitalization efforts. Concurrently, the retailer is establishing a Marketing Shared Services organization to centralize key media functions, as part of a broader strategy following a recent change in its flagship Gap brand's global CMO and improved Q4 net sales. The move comes after a review of its U.S. media agency assignment and is expected to be fully implemented by the end of Q2.

title: Now Streaming: Queen Rock Montreal with IMAX® Enhanced Sound on Disney+
summary: IMAX announced that "Queen Rock Montreal" is now streaming on Disney+ with IMAX Enhanced Sound. This release marks a significant collaboration between IMAX and Disney+ to bring a high-fidelity audio experience of Queen's iconic concert to home viewers.

title: Disney-Fox-Warner Sports Streaming Service Gets a Name and Logo: Venu Sports
summary: The upcoming sports streaming service from Disney, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Fox has been officially named Venu Sports. The service, still awaiting regulatory approval, is slated to launch this fall and aims to provide a centralized platform for live sports content for fans outside traditional pay-TV. Pete Distad, CEO of the platform, emphasized its goal of offering a best-in-class product built with the latest technologies.

title: Venu Sports: FOX, ESPN, Warner Bros. Discovery announce joint streaming service
summary: Fox Corporation, Disney, and Warner Bros. Discovery have officially announced their joint sports streaming service, named Venu Sports. Scheduled to launch in the United States this fall, Venu Sports will offer subscribers access to a wide range of professional and college sports content from all three companies, including major leagues like the NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL. The service will be available as a standalone app and can also be bundled with other streaming platforms like Disney+, Hulu, or Max, pending regulatory approval.

title: Venu Sports: Disney, Fox, Warner Bros. Discovery streaming partners unveil forthcoming name to sports super streamer
summary: Disney, Fox, and Warner Bros. Discovery have announced "Venu Sports" as the official name for their new sports streaming service, set to launch in the fall. The platform aims to provide a comprehensive collection of live sports content from ESPN, FOX, and Warner Bros. Discovery to fans outside the traditional pay-TV ecosystem. This initiative follows a broader trend of media companies moving into streaming, with Disney and Warner Bros. Discovery also planning to launch a bundle service combining Disney+, Hulu, and Max this summer.

title: Venu Sports Introduced as Name for Forthcoming Sports Streaming Service
summary: The forthcoming sports streaming service, a joint venture between ESPN, Fox, and Warner Bros. Discovery, has officially been named Venu Sports. CEO Pete Distad unveiled the brand identity, emphasizing the platform's goal to provide an all-new streaming home for sports fans outside traditional pay TV, offering a wide collection of live sports. Venu Sports is scheduled to launch in the U.S. in the fall of 2024, aggregating content from various sports networks and ESPN+, and will also offer bundling options with Disney+, Hulu, or Max.

title: Post Performance Report: Brands turning IRL events into online engagement
summary: This report highlights how brands are effectively leveraging in-person events to generate online engagement and cultivate brand love. It showcases examples from Rhode at Coachella, Rocket Mortgage at the NFL Draft, TikTok at the Met Gala, Topgolf during The Masters, and the Kentucky Derby, demonstrating various strategies for social-first promotion and sustained cultural relevance. The article provides key takeaways for brands to maximize their event-related social media efforts.

title: CEO succession can be a tricky business, and not just on TV
summary: The upcoming departure of JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon highlights the complexities of CEO succession. The article discusses how long-serving CEOs become deeply intertwined with their company's image, making transitions difficult, and points out the challenges when outgoing CEOs remain too involved, potentially hindering new leadership. Experts emphasize that boards need to give new CEOs space to establish their own path rather than seeking a carbon copy of their predecessor.

title: NBA Finals Basketball Games to Screen Live on Imax in Hong Kong, Taiwan
summary: Imax China has secured a deal with NBA China to screen the NBA Finals live in select Imax cinemas across Hong Kong and Taiwan, marking a first-time live sports offering for Imax in these regions. The collaboration expands Imax's content strategy beyond blockbuster movies, following the success of concert films like "Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour." The screenings are scheduled to begin on June 6, bringing immersive sports entertainment to audiences.

title: Sustainability at Disney: a holistic approach
summary: This article details Walt Disney Imagineering's holistic approach to sustainability, as discussed at greenloop 24. It covers Disney's commitment to reducing Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions, its participation in the Science Based Targets initiative, and various global initiatives across its parks, including solar power expansion, electrification of attractions, water conservation, and sustainable building practices. The company emphasizes a story-driven, collaborative, and long-term resilient strategy for environmental goals.

title: Disney Accelerator at 10: Innovating and Looking Towards the Future
summary: The Disney Accelerator program celebrates its 10th anniversary, highlighting its role in fostering innovation by connecting growth-stage companies with Disney executives. Key successes include Sphero creating the BB-8 droid, Epic Games' collaboration leading to a $1.5 billion investment, and Kahoot!'s educational platform integrating Disney characters. The program aims to continue advancing storytelling and creating new entertainment experiences through technology.

title: Form FWP Seaport Entertainment Filed by: Seaport Entertainment Group Inc.
summary: Seaport Entertainment Group Inc. filed a Free Writing Prospectus on May 24, 2024, related to its preliminary prospectus for a rights offering. The company is set to be spun off from Howard Hughes Holdings Inc. and will own and operate hospitality and entertainment assets primarily in New York City and Las Vegas. Following the spin-off, Seaport Entertainment plans a $175 million rights offering, backstopped by Pershing Square Capital Management, L.P., to ensure ample liquidity for its business plan.

title: BIA: Here’s 2023’s Top Ten Revenue Generating Station Owners.
summary: A new report from BIA shows that iHeartMedia remains the top revenue-generating radio station owner in 2023, followed by Audacy and Cumulus Media. While most top five owners experienced single-digit revenue declines, Urban One and Alpha Media bucked the trend with slight increases, moving up in the rankings. The report highlights that declines were expected in a non-political year, with specific stations like WTOP Washington D.C. significantly contributing to their owners' overall revenue.

title: Disney Named to TIME’s List of the Most Influential Companies
summary: The Walt Disney Company has been recognized by TIME magazine for the fourth consecutive year, appearing on its TIME100 Most Influential Companies list. The list acknowledges companies making a significant global impact, and Disney was the sole media and entertainment company featured this year. TIME highlighted Disney's competitive strength in entertainment and its focus on streaming profitability as key factors for its inclusion.

title: Meet The Team - Magnite's strategy for a cookieless future
summary: Magnite is preparing for a cookieless future by leveraging its core streaming business, which already operates without third-party cookies, and utilizing alternative identifiers like IDFAs and first-party data. The company emphasizes the importance of publisher-defined audiences and sees Australia as a key testbed for ad-supported offerings from major businesses. Magnite's team members also discuss their focus on driving revenue growth for publishers, enhancing platform interoperability, and the evolving landscape of programmatic advertising.

title: LA500 2024: Stephen G. Berman
summary: Stephen G. Berman, co-founder and chief executive of Jakks Pacific Inc., is featured in the LA500 2024 list. Under his leadership, the toy company reported net sales of $712 million last year, despite an 11% year-over-year decrease. Jakks Pacific, known for its proprietary brands and licensed products from major entertainment companies, also saw an increase in adjusted net income to $48.9 million.

title: Federal Campaign Contributions of Comcast’s 2024 Director Nominees
summary: The National Legal and Policy Center (NLPC) submitted a shareholder proposal to Comcast regarding director transparency, specifically requesting disclosure of political and charitable giving to help shareholders understand potential ideological biases. Comcast, unlike other companies like Alphabet, Amazon, and Home Depot, blocked the proposal, claiming it would "micromanage" the company and seek "personal, intimate details." In response, NLPC published the federal campaign contribution records of Comcast's 2024 director nominees, arguing that transparency is crucial, especially for influential media companies like Comcast, to ensure broader ideological representation on its board.

title: Disney Announces Major Gift to London's Great Ormond Street, Furthering Commitment to Children's Hospitals
summary: The Walt Disney Company CEO Bob Iger announced a significant donation to London's Great Ormond Street Hospital (GOSH) to create a fully accessible MediCinema theater. This initiative is part of Disney's $100 million global commitment to reimagine the patient experience in children's hospitals. The new theater will bring movie magic to patients, their families, and staff, continuing Disney's long-standing support for GOSH.

title: Fantasy Springs’ Magical Opening: What You Need to Know
summary: Fantasy Springs, the eighth themed port at Tokyo DisneySea Park, officially opens on June 6, 2024, bringing to life beloved Disney Animation stories like Rapunzel's Forest, Peter Pan's Never Land, and Frozen Kingdom. This expansion includes new attractions, themed restaurants, and the park-integrated Tokyo DisneySea Fantasy Springs Hotel. CEO Bob Iger highlighted the long-standing collaboration with Oriental Land Company and their shared commitment to excellence in immersive experiences.

title: AMC Stock's Rally: The Hidden Truth and Why It’s Temporary
summary: The article argues that AMC stock's recent rally, similar to GameStop's, is a temporary "fake rally" and not a sustainable revival of the 2021 meme stock phenomenon. It attributes this to significant differences in today's market conditions, such as higher interest rates, and fundamental issues within AMC, including shareholder dilution and negative cash flow. Analysts forecast a double-digit downside for AMC, and rising short interest along with institutional outflows indicate a bearish outlook.

title: Affirm’s BNPL And Tap to Cash Are Coming to Apple Pay Later This Year
summary: Apple is expanding its financial services with new features for iOS18, including "Tap to Cash" for iPhone-to-iPhone transfers and broader Apple Pay availability for third-party browsers. Notably, Affirm's buy now, pay later service will integrate into Apple Pay later this year, allowing users to apply for loans directly at checkout. Apple is also enhancing reward redemption and installment loan offers within Apple Pay, building on its own Apple Pay Later service launched in 2023.

title: Trian Partners Acquires ’Significant‘ Stake in Rentokil Initial
summary: Activist investor Nelson Peltz's Trian Fund Management has acquired a significant stake in Rentokil Initial, becoming one of its 10 largest shareholders. Trian reportedly seeks to discuss ideas to improve shareholder value, potentially pushing for a U.S. listing to enhance valuation compared to its American peers. This move follows Trian's recent divestment from the Walt Disney Company.

title: Spin-off da UFMG é adquirida pelo Grupo Bradesco
summary: The UFMG spin-off Kunumi, co-founded by professor Nívio Ziviani and CEO Alberto Colares, has been acquired by Bradesco Holding de Investimentos S.A. Kunumi, established in 2016, specializes in artificial intelligence, developing a platform that mimics brain function to analyze large datasets and solve complex problems. This acquisition highlights an innovative legal model where UFMG, as a co-founder, benefits from the company's success through an usufruct of shares agreement.

title: Orlando Theme Park Enters Crisis Lockdown, All Guests Evacuated From Park
summary: Aquatica, SeaWorld's water park in Orlando, experienced a lockdown and evacuation yesterday due to a large fight involving approximately 100 guests. Police were called to disperse the altercation, which reportedly started between two guests and escalated. This incident follows other recent issues in Orlando theme parks, including guest misbehavior and a recent visitor death at Discovery Cove.

title: ‘Inside Out 2’ Smashes Global and Domestic Box Office Records
summary: Pixar's "Inside Out 2" shattered box office records on its opening weekend, earning an estimated $154 million domestically and $292 million globally. This makes it not only the biggest box office opening of the year but also the second-biggest animated domestic opening and the biggest global animated opening of all-time. The film was praised by critics and audiences alike, with director Kelsey Mann emphasizing the expanded storyline from the first film.

title: The New Disney x Columbia Collaboration Has Arrived
summary: Disney and Columbia have launched a new collaboration featuring adventurous apparel inspired by Mickey and Friends. The collection includes a booney hat, hip pack, baseball cap, long sleeve t-shirt, and a camp shirt, all designed for summer adventures and Disney Parks trips. This release is part of a three-part series highlighting the latest Disney merchandise.

title: How ‘Country Bear Musical Jamboree’ Is Adding a Country Twist to Classic Disney Songs
summary: The reimagined "Country Bear Musical Jamboree" will open on July 17 at Magic Kingdom Park, featuring Audio-Animatronic bears performing a medley of original and classic songs, including countryfied Disney tunes for the first time. Imagineers collaborated with country music stars to reinterpret songs like "The Bare Necessities" and "Try Everything" into various country genres. Emily Ann Roberts, who voices Trixie St. Claire, expressed excitement about lending her voice to a Disney attraction, emphasizing the blending of diverse talents to create a special experience.

title: New CEOs Take Over at the North Texas Disability Chamber and Investment Platform Nada
summary: The article announces new CEO appointments at the North Texas Disability Chamber and investment platform Nada. It also details several other C-suite and executive hires and promotions at various North Texas companies, including MoneyGram, North Dallas Bank and Trust, Foundry Commercial, CG Infinity, Brinker International, Skytale Group, and Cloud Communications Group. These appointments span finance, analytics, real estate, software, and cybersecurity sectors.

title: Venu Sports Announces Management Team Under CEO Pete Distad
summary: Venu Sports, a joint venture by Disney, Fox, and Warner Bros. Discovery, announced its executive team under CEO Pete Distad. Key hires include Brian Borkowski as CMO, Jessica Casano-Antonellis as SVP and head of communications, Tim Connolly as chief business officer, Amit Dudakia as SVP and head of product, Skarpi Hedinsson as CTO, David Hillman as chief legal officer, Gautam Ranji as CFO, and Judy Schwab as SVP and head of people, all bringing extensive experience from major media and tech companies.

title: 4 Reasons to Buy Walt Disney Stock Like There's No Tomorrow
summary: The article argues for buying Walt Disney stock, highlighting four key reasons: the end of the proxy battle with Nelson Peltz, the streaming business achieving profitability, the upcoming launch of a stand-alone ESPN streaming service, and the stock being considered undervalued by analysts. Despite lingering risks in traditional segments like theatrical films and theme parks, the author suggests Disney's current valuation offers a good entry point for investors.

title: Shari Redstone Goes for Broke: Can Paramount Pick Up the Pieces?
summary: The article discusses the uncertain future of Paramount Global following Shari Redstone's decision to back away from a potential sale months after deep conversations with Skydance and others. It introduces new potential suitors and outlines the strategic plans of Paramount's co-CEOs, while also highlighting key figures who were previously involved or are still in the mix, such as Charles Phillips, Edgar Bronfman Jr., Steven Paul, and Sony/Apollo, and David Zaslav.

title: Sprouts Farmers Market Named “Official Grocer of the Southeastern Conference”
summary: Sprouts Farmers Market has signed a multi-year sponsorship deal to become the "Official Grocer of the Southeastern Conference," focusing on women's sports and championships. This partnership will integrate Sprouts into SEC Network programming and events, including on-site activations at major championships. The collaboration aims to promote healthier lifestyles and further equity in women's sports, building on Sprouts' existing engagement with ESPN through events like the Sprouts Farmers Market Collegiate Quad.

title: PENN Shares Spike On Potential Acquisition Bid By Boyd Gaming
summary: Shares of PENN Entertainment spiked by 9% following reports that Boyd Gaming Corp. has approached PENN regarding a potential acquisition. This news comes after activist investor Donerail Group pressured PENN to sell the company, citing dissatisfaction with its digital spending and inability to generate meaningful returns from its online gambling segment, including ESPN BET. The relative sizes of the two companies, with PENN valued at $9 billion and Boyd at $7.8 billion, could present complications for negotiations.

title: Elon Musk Confirms AI Gains Traction Fast
summary: Elon Musk, during a recent interview at the Cannes Lions conference, revealed that AI adoption is spreading rapidly, citing his university-aged son's experience with classmates extensively using AI for writing. He also humorously described his approach to spending his vast wealth. Musk reiterated his prior prediction that AI could surpass human capabilities in less than three years.

title: Putting Penn to paper: Will Boyd Gaming acquire Penn Entertainment?
summary: Boyd Gaming is reportedly considering acquiring Penn Entertainment for an estimated $9 billion, a deal complicated by potential antitrust issues due to significant market overlap and Penn's partnership with ESPN Bet. Penn Entertainment has also faced recent investor discontent over management decisions and declining stock performance, making the timing opportune for such a move. The acquisition would likely necessitate the sale of numerous properties and clearance from Walt Disney for the ESPN Bet brand, posing significant challenges and creating opportunities for other operators and activist investors.

title: How Cruise Lines Will Comply with California’s New Honest Pricing Law
summary: A new California law, the "Honest Pricing Law" (SB 478), goes into effect July 1, 2024, requiring businesses, including cruise lines, to include all necessary fees and charges in advertised prices. Major cruise lines like Carnival Corporation, MSC Cruises, Royal Caribbean Group, Norwegian Cruise Line, and Disney Cruise Line are complying with this new law, with many extending the practice nationwide for consistency. This change means consumers will see the total, all-in price upfront, rather than having taxes and fees added later in the booking process, simplifying budgeting without altering the final cost.

title: Winnie the Pooh is a getting an AI-assisted cartoon makeover, courtesy of Amazon's Prime Video (Sorry, Disney)
summary: Amazon Prime Video is launching a new AI-assisted animated series and holiday specials featuring Winnie the Pooh, Piglet, and Tigger, capitalizing on the character's expired copyright. This move allows them to create content and merchandise without Disney's approval, as long as they adhere to A.A. Milne's original designs and avoid Disney's specific trademarks. The first holiday special is set for release on December 25, 2025.

title: Streaming Profits Are Tough to Find. Niche Movie and TV Platforms See a Way Forward
summary: As major streaming platforms struggle with subscriber churn and profitability, niche movie and TV platforms like Crunchyroll, Shudder, Acorn TV, and Cineverse are finding success by catering to highly engaged, specialized audiences. These smaller services emphasize loyalty and provide unique content that larger platforms often overlook, leveraging more cost-effective production models. While facing challenges in content volume and technology budgets compared to giants like Netflix, these niche streamers believe their focused approach fosters stronger subscriber retention and a sustainable business model in the competitive streaming landscape.

title: Fumble! Your Favorite NFL Team Is On The Hook For $450 Million In Sunday Ticket Lawsuit, 1.76x More Than Player Pay In 2024
summary: A federal jury has ruled that the NFL must pay between $4.7 billion and $14.4 billion in damages due to a class-action lawsuit over anticompetitive practices related to the Sunday Ticket television package. If the maximum amount is upheld, each of the 32 NFL teams would be liable for approximately $450 million, an amount significantly higher than their 2024 player salaries. The NFL plans to appeal the verdict.

title: Appetite for FX’s ‘The Bear’ Continues to Grow with Season 3, Setting Records for FX
summary: The third season premiere of FX's "The Bear" achieved a record 5.4 million views globally in its first four days, marking a 24% increase over season two and making it the most-watched FX and scripted season premiere ever on Hulu. The show's continued popularity follows its success at major awards and saw increased viewership for its first two seasons leading up to the new premiere. Starring Jeremy Allen White, Ayo Edebiri, and Ebon Moss-Bachrach, the series follows their characters as they strive to elevate their restaurant.

title: LINDBLAD EXPEDITIONS-NATIONAL GEOGRAPHIC UNVEILS TWO NEW GALÁPAGOS VESSELS: NATIONAL GEOGRAPHIC DELFINA AND NATIONAL GEOGRAPHIC GEMINI
summary: Lindblad Expeditions-National Geographic has announced the addition of two new vessels, National Geographic Delfina and National Geographic Gemini, to its Galápagos fleet, effectively doubling its presence in the region. These purpose-built ships will begin voyages in February and March 2025, offering increased opportunities for travelers to explore the Galápagos Islands with enhanced expedition staff and amenities. The new vessels emphasize intimate experiences, local immersion through Ecuadorian-crafted food and decor, and state-of-the-art exploration tools.

title: Movie Viewers Increasingly Want Imax Theatre Experience At Home
summary: As movie theatre attendance remains below pre-pandemic levels, a growing number of consumers are looking to replicate the IMAX experience at home through programs like "IMAX Enhanced." This certification ensures compatible devices meet high audio and video standards and utilize IMAX formats, including 4K resolution, HDR, IMAX aspect ratio, and DTS:X immersive sound. A survey by Xperi, the parent company of DTS, found that over half of respondents prioritize theatrical-like sound and are willing to spend on audio equipment for an enhanced home viewing experience.

title: Discovery Shareholders Win $125M Settlement Of Lawsuit Over 2022 AT&T Merger
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery has agreed to a $125 million settlement in a shareholder lawsuit concerning the 2022 merger of AT&T's WarnerMedia and Discovery Communications. The lawsuit alleged that the $43 billion merger unfairly benefited top-tier investors at Discovery while leaving common shareholders at a disadvantage, with specific payouts to select insiders. The settlement, awaiting court approval, will see former Discovery shareholders eligible for funds, with a significant portion contributed by the Advance/Newhouse Partnership and Robert and Steven Miron.

title: These two amusement park giants just merged. Rollercoaster fans are nervous
summary: Six Flags and Cedar Fair have completed an $8 billion merger, creating the largest amusement park operator in the US, with rollercoaster fans expressing both optimism for park improvements and concerns about rising costs and loss of park identity. The new company, Six Flags Entertainment Corp., will be majority-owned by Cedar Fair, whose CEO Richard Zimmerman will lead the entity, leading to hopes that Cedar Fair's stronger management style will address Six Flags' recent struggles with attendance and customer experience. While no immediate changes to pricing or branding are expected, fans are anticipating potential developments in season pass options, loyalty programs, and the combined use of intellectual properties like Looney Tunes and Peanuts characters.

title: Why Morgan Stanley teamed with Disney to sponsor a Serena Williams docuseries
summary: Morgan Stanley is the presenting sponsor for the upcoming "In The Arena: Serena Williams" docuseries on ESPN+, a move driven by the financial services firm's commitment to amplifying women's sports. CMO Alice Milligan explains that this sponsorship aligns with Morgan Stanley's broader marketing strategy to modernize its brand, appeal to a new generation of investors, and showcase core values like supporting women and young girls. The initiative reflects a growing trend in the ad industry to invest in women's elite sports, a market projected to surpass $1 billion in revenue this year.

title: Disney and Oriental Land Co., Ltd. to Launch Disney Cruise Vacations in Japan
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced that Disney Cruise Line, in partnership with Oriental Land Co., Ltd., will launch Disney Cruise Vacations in Japan. This expansion builds on Disney Cruise Line's global presence, which already includes voyages to various destinations worldwide and planned year-round cruises from Singapore starting in 2025. The new offering will bring Disney's cruise experience to the Japanese market.

title: New Four Seasons luxury project begins construction in Disney's Golden Oak community
summary: Construction has commenced on a new Four Seasons Private Residences project within Disney's Golden Oak community. Developed by Host Hotels & Resorts Inc., this luxury development was announced by the Orlando Business Journal. The article provides details on this high-end addition to the Disney area.

title: New Winnie the Pooh Movie Coming Out This Christmas Has Fans Worried
summary: Amazon and Kartoon Studios are releasing a new Winnie the Pooh animated movie, "A Hundred Acre Christmas," along with specials and a series, after A.A. Milne's original copyright expired. Fans are concerned about the project, particularly regarding the use of AI in character creation and what they perceive as a lack of care and an attempt to profit from Disney's established brand without sufficient originality. The film is slated for release on December 25, 2025, on Amazon Prime Video.

title: Another big name in sports gambling joining D.C.'s mobile betting fray
summary: Caesars Sportsbook is launching its mobile betting app in Washington D.C., increasing competition in the city's sports betting market. This new entry will compete with established player FanDuel and newcomer BetMGM. The rollout is expected early Monday morning, adding another significant player to the local mobile sports gambling scene.

title: With 70% institutional ownership, The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) is a favorite amongst the big guns
summary: The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) is heavily favored by institutional investors, who own 70% of the company, indicating significant confidence in its future. The Vanguard Group is the largest shareholder with 8.4%, and the top 25 shareholders collectively own 40% of the company, meaning no single entity holds a majority interest. While individual investors hold a 30% stake, insider ownership is less than 1%.

title: Flutter Sizes Up Penn Interactive Assets Amid Boyd Interest - EXCLUSIVE
summary: Flutter Entertainment plc (FLUT) is reportedly interested in partnering with Boyd Gaming Corp. (BYD) to acquire the interactive assets of Penn Entertainment Inc. (PENN). This potential move comes as Boyd Gaming has also shown interest in Penn, with a proposed deal seeing Boyd taking Penn's physical casinos and Flutter acquiring its ESPN Bet partnership and Score Media business. Both Flutter and Boyd have made recent board appointments that suggest preparation for such M&A activity and ESPN-related contract negotiations.

title: Cosplay Meets Condiments: HEINZ to Release Limited-Edition Ketchup and Mustard Collectibles Inspired by Marvel Studios’ “Deadpool & Wolverine”
summary: HEINZ is releasing limited-edition ketchup and mustard collectibles inspired by Marvel Studios’ “Deadpool & Wolverine” due to perceived similarities between the characters' suits and the condiment colors. The collaboration includes accessories for bottles to resemble Deadpool and Wolverine, accompanied by a campaign featuring Ryan Reynolds. Fans can look forward to more details on how to get these collectibles via HEINZ's social media channels in the coming weeks.

title: Despicable Me First Animated Franchise To Hit $5B: Here Are The Top Grossing Movie Franchises Ever
summary: Comcast's "Despicable Me" franchise has become the first animated series to surpass $5 billion in global box office earnings, largely driven by the recent success of "Despicable Me 4." This milestone solidifies its position as the highest-grossing animated franchise worldwide. The article details the top-grossing film franchises globally and domestically, highlighting the dominance of companies like Disney and Warner Bros. Discovery.

title: Disney Announces Expansive Shopping Opportunities and Exclusive Merchandise Available to Guests at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event
summary: Disney has announced extensive shopping experiences and exclusive merchandise for D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event, featuring new retail locations and advanced technology to enhance the shopping experience. Attendees can explore a wide range of limited-edition items from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, and Star Wars, including new product debuts and collectible titles. The event will utilize merchandise mobile checkout and virtual queues through the Disney D23 and Disneyland apps to streamline shopping.

title: The Walt Disney Company Earns Record-Breaking 183 Emmy® Award Nominations, Makes History with Three Most-Nominated Series of the Year
summary: The Walt Disney Company has received a record-breaking 183 nominations for the 76th Primetime Emmy Awards across its various content brands and studios. Notably, Disney is home to the three most-nominated series of the year: "Shōgun," "The Bear," and "Only Murders in the Building." The nominations highlight significant achievements for FX, Hulu Originals, and ABC, including multiple program and individual acting/writing nods.

title: Oracle CEO Safra Catz exits Disney’s board of directors
summary: Oracle CEO Safra Catz is departing from the Walt Disney Co. board of directors after serving for six years. Her exit brings the board down to 11 members, with Disney CEO Bob Iger acknowledging her significant contributions to the company's strategic planning. This move occurs as Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, Catz's colleague, has increased his involvement in the entertainment sector, notably backing his son's acquisition of National Amusements Inc., which affects Disney competitor Paramount Global.

title: Universal theme park earnings dip like a roller coaster in latest report
summary: Comcast reported an 11% drop in theme park revenue for Universal, totaling $1.98 billion, which company leaders attribute to the absence of new major rides since 2021. Despite this dip in earnings, which fell below original expectations, Comcast remains optimistic about long-term growth, citing strong consumer excitement for the upcoming Epic Universe park slated to open in Summer 2025. This new park will feature diverse themed lands and is expected to revitalize attendance.

title: ‘Inside Out 2’ Becomes the Highest-Grossing Animated Film of All Time Globally
summary: Pixar's "Inside Out 2" has become the highest-grossing animated film globally, earning $1.46 billion worldwide and surpassing "Frozen II." It is also the 13th highest-grossing film of all time globally and the only movie in 2024 to cross the $1 billion mark, achieving this feat in record time. The film's success extends beyond box office numbers, reinforcing the "Inside Out" brand as one of Pixar's most recognizable titles.

title: New Disney+, Hulu, Max Bundle Is Now Available in Ad-Supported and Ad-Free Plans
summary: Disney Entertainment and Warner Bros. Discovery have launched a new bundle offering Disney+, Hulu, and Max in ad-supported and ad-free plans in the U.S. Available for $16.99/month with ads or $29.99/month without ads, this bundle offers significant savings. It combines extensive content from various popular brands, supported by a coordinated national marketing campaign focusing on fan-favorite TV series, films, and characters.

title: Apollo leads $700m investment into Sony Music Group partnership. (It’s a kind of magic!)
summary: Apollo Global Management has confirmed its lead investment in a USD $700 million "capital solution" for Sony Music Group. This funding is aimed at enabling Sony Music Group to make further investments in the music industry, including their recent reported acquisition of Queen's catalog. Apollo has a history of significant investments in the music rights market, having previously backed Concord and HarbourView Equity Partners.

title: WBD takes NBA to court in legal showdown over broadcast rights
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) has sued the NBA after the league rejected WBD's matching offer to continue broadcasting live games, ending their four-decade relationship. WBD argues it had a contractual right to match Amazon's $1.8 billion per year bid for broadcast rights. The NBA, which entered new 11-year contracts with Amazon, NBCUniversal, and Disney worth $76 billion, claims WBD did not match the terms of Amazon's offer.

title: ‘Deadpool & Wolverine’ Breaks Box Office Records with Largest R-rated Global Opening Ever
summary: Marvel Studios' "Deadpool & Wolverine" has shattered box office records, achieving the highest-grossing global opening for an R-rated film with $444.1 million worldwide, including $211 million domestically. The film is also the 6th highest-grossing domestic opening of all time and the biggest July opening weekend ever. Director Shawn Levy and producer Kevin Feige credit the film's success to its blend of action, humor, and an unexpected warmth in the relationship between the two main characters.

title: How Walt Disney World’s Award-Winning ‘This Is Magic’ Campaign Came Together
summary: This article details the making of Walt Disney World's award-winning "This Is Magic" advertising campaign, which sought to capture authentic guest moments at the resort. The campaign, which won a Silver Lion at the Cannes Lions Festival of Creativity, used unscripted footage of 259 real people to showcase the unique connection guests have with Disney. It achieved massive exposure through linear television, digital platforms, and a groundbreaking social media takeover.

title: AMC and IMAX shares climb, boosted by huge ‘Deadpool & Wolverine’ opening weekend
summary: Shares of AMC Entertainment Holdings Inc. rose after "Deadpool & Wolverine" achieved record-breaking opening weekend attendance and admissions revenue for an R-rated film at AMC's U.S. locations. The movie also contributed to AMC's highest worldwide weekend attendance and admissions revenue for 2024. These strong box office results positively impacted both AMC and IMAX shares.

title: How Walt Disney World’s Award-Winning ‘This Is Magic’ Campaign Came Together
summary: Walt Disney World's "This Is Magic" campaign, which recently won a Silver Lion at the Cannes Lions Festival of Creativity, aimed to capture authentic guest moments at the park. Developed by Walt Disney World Marketing, Yellow Shoes, and Dentsu, the campaign focused on real people enjoying their vacations without scripts or elaborate production. It launched during Dick Clark’s New Years Rockin’ Eve and achieved massive exposure through television and social media takeovers, resonating deeply with both audiences and Disney cast members.

title: The State of the Global Summer Box Office
summary: Comscore Senior Media Analyst Paul Dergarabedian reviews the global summer box office, noting its emotional highs and lows, similar to Riley in "Inside Out 2." He highlights the rescue efforts of "Bad Boys" and "Minions" in June, turning May's gloom into a July boom, with "Deadpool & Wolverine" contributing to a spectacular summer weekend for theaters.

title: North Texas-based Cinemark just saw its biggest summer movie opening of all-time
summary: Cinemark Holdings, Inc. announced that "Deadpool & Wolverine" broke multiple company records for its domestic box office opening and concessions revenue, marking its highest-ever domestic opening for a summer film and biggest opening weekend for its premium formats. The film also contributed to Cinemark's highest concessions revenue since the pandemic, with total North American box office surpassing $205 million, making it the biggest July opening and highest-grossing R-rated film ever. Cinemark's President and CEO, Sean Gamble, expressed optimism about the future of theatrical exhibition following this success.

title: 'Disney Destiny' Will Introduce New 'The Lion King' Restaurant, 'The Incredibles' Sweet Shop, and More Hero-Worthy Features
summary: Disney Cruise Line's new ship, the Disney Destiny, setting sail in late 2025, will feature themed experiences inspired by Disney heroes and villains. Highlights include "Pride Lands: Feast of The Lion King," a new dining experience, and "Edna Á La Mode Sweets," an "Incredibles"-themed confectionary. The ship will also offer two new cafes and hero-worthy staterooms, including royal suites based on Hercules and The Incredibles.

title: Etsy CFO Rachel Glaser to Retire
summary: Etsy, Inc. announced that its Chief Financial Officer, Rachel Glaser, will retire after a nearly 40-year career, including over seven years at Etsy. She will remain in her role until a successor is found and then serve in an advisory capacity until June 30, 2025, to ensure a smooth transition. During her tenure, Etsy experienced significant growth in gross merchandise sales, revenue, and adjusted EBITDA margins, with seller and buyer communities expanding substantially.

title: Disney Princesses Come Together to Inspire Girls to "Create Your World" Through New Multi-Year Brand Campaign
summary: Disney has launched a new multi-year brand campaign called "Create Your World" to inspire girls through Disney Princesses. The campaign includes new content, music releases, parks experiences, and consumer products, emphasizing imagination and self-belief. It also features collaborations with musical artists, celebrations of film anniversaries, and partnerships with Make-A-Wish and Starlight Children’s Foundation.

title: Disney television unit hit with 140 layoffs, including cuts at National Geographic
summary: Walt Disney Co.'s television division is laying off 140 people, about 2% of its workforce, as part of a companywide cost-cutting plan. The cuts primarily affect National Geographic, Freeform, locally owned TV stations, and marketing/publicity teams, with National Geographic seeing a 13% reduction. This move continues Disney's efforts to save money and mitigate losses from its streaming business, following earlier plans to cut thousands of jobs and billions in costs.

title: Marcus CEO On The Welcome Return Of A “Normal” Film Slate & State Of Exhibition M&A
summary: Marcus Theatres reported a dip in revenue and profit for the previous quarter but saw a significant positive shift in June due to a "normal" film slate featuring tentpole releases after a soft April and May. CEO Greg Marcus emphasized the importance of big theatrical releases for the industry's recovery, noting strong performances from films like "Inside Out 2" and "Deadpool & Wolverine." The company is also acquiring individual theaters but is not looking to acquire entire circuits due to financial complexities.

title: FOX REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER FISCAL 2024 REVENUES OF $3.09 BILLION, NET INCOME OF $320 MILLION, AND ADJUSTED EBITDA OF $773 MILLION
summary: Fox Corporation (FOXA, FOX) reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2024 revenues of $3.09 billion, a 2% increase, and adjusted EBITDA of $773 million, up 5% from the prior year. For the full fiscal year 2024, the company achieved $13.98 billion in revenues and $2.88 billion in Adjusted EBITDA. The company highlighted strong affiliate revenue growth, Tubi's performance, and reinvigorated ratings at FOX News, and increased its semi-annual dividend to $0.27 per share.

title: Walt Disney Warns Theme Park Revenue to Fall, Profit Slips Amid Economic Worries
summary: Walt Disney Co. projects a "moderation in demand" and a mid-single-digit drop in operating income for its theme parks in the fiscal fourth quarter, despite successes like "Inside Out 2" and profitable streaming. This outlook is attributed to consumer spending being pinched by inflation and broader economic worries, although the company's overall revenue and adjusted earnings per share still beat analyst estimates.

title: Ziff Davis Buying CNET For Over $100 Million, Says Report
summary: Ziff Davis is reportedly acquiring CNET for over $100 million. CNET has a complex ownership history, having been bought by CBS in 2008 and then sold to Red Ventures in 2020. The deal is expected to close in Q3 2023, and Ziff Davis CEO Vivek Shah indicates more M&A deals are anticipated.

title: Insider Buying: Director Calvin McDonald Acquires Shares of The Walt Disney Co (DIS)
summary: The Walt Disney Co (DIS) Director Calvin McDonald purchased 11,756 shares on August 8, 2024, increasing his total holdings to 22,312.9 shares. This transaction signals a positive outlook from the insider, especially as Disney's stock is considered Modestly Undervalued with a GF Value of $110.44. The company's shares were priced at $85.06 at the time of the transaction, and its price-earnings ratio stands at 33.16.

title: Disney CEO Bob Iger Highlights Company’s 'Unmatched Strength' at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event
summary: Disney CEO Bob Iger kicked off D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event by emphasizing the company's "unmatched strength" in creativity, innovation, and storytelling, forged over a century. He highlighted Disney's deep bond with fans, the wide appeal of its brands, and its unique ability to bring stories to life in various forms, including theme parks. Iger expressed gratitude to fans for inviting Disney into their lives and reiterated the company's mission to entertain, thrill, and bring joy.

title: ‘Walt Disney — A Magical Life’ Features the First Audio-Animatronics Figure of Walt. Here’s How Imagineers Created the Attraction
summary: A new attraction, ‘Walt Disney – A Magical Life,’ featuring the first Audio-Animatronics figure of Walt Disney, will debut at Disneyland's Main Street Opera House in 2025. Announced by Disney Experiences Chairman Josh D’Amaro, this show will showcase an advanced Audio-Animatronics figure of Walt, utilizing technology pioneered by Disney 60 years ago. Imagineers, in collaboration with the Walt Disney Archives, focused on capturing Walt’s essence and personality to create a lifelike and inspirational experience for all ages.

title: Capital One insists Discover deal won’t increase card fees
summary: Capital One is defending its proposed $35 billion merger with Discover Financial, asserting that the deal will not lead to increased card fees for consumers. In a letter to regulators, Capital One argued that ongoing competition in the credit card market would compel it to maintain competitive pricing. The bank also highlighted its commitment to financial inclusiveness for consumers across various credit scores, despite concerns from advocacy groups about market concentration for non-prime cardholders.

title: Disney Names Adam Smith Chief Product & Technology Officer, Disney Entertainment & ESPN
summary: Adam Smith has been appointed Chief Product & Technology Officer for Disney Entertainment and ESPN, a role in which he will oversee a global product and technology group for Disney's entertainment and sports media businesses. He will be responsible for technology strategy, development, and innovation across streaming platforms, consumer digital touchpoints, and advertising technology. Smith joins Disney from YouTube, where he spent over 20 years with Google and YouTube in various executive roles, most recently as Vice President, Product Management for Music, Premium, Subscriptions, and Commerce.

title: 2023 TEA/AECOM Theme Index and Museum Index released; post-COVID recovery period ends
summary: The 2023 TEA/AECOM Theme Index and Museum Index reports that the post-COVID recovery period has ended, with global theme park attendance increasing by 23% and museum attendance by 95% over 2022. While China saw significant rebounds, the Americas experienced a modest 3% rise, and Europe demonstrated strong growth. The report highlights increased per capita spending at attractions and a shift towards more interactive exhibits in museums, indicating positive trends for the cultural attractions and theme park markets.

title: ‘Alien: Romulus’ Scares Up a Big Opening to Top the Box Office
summary: 20th Century Studios' "Alien: Romulus" exceeded expectations with a $41.8 million domestic opening, making it the second biggest opening in the Alien series and director Fede Alvarez’s best. The film, which also earned $109.9 million worldwide, contributed to The Walt Disney Studios holding the top two spots at the domestic box office this weekend. This success further bolstered Disney's strong summer, which included the highest-grossing animated film "Inside Out 2" and the highest-grossing R-rated film "Deadpool & Wolverine."

title: FuboTV Stock Soars on Judge's Ruling on Disney-Fox-Warner Bros. Discover JV
summary: FuboTV shares jumped significantly following a judge's ruling that temporarily blocks the launch of Venu Sports, a joint streaming venture by Disney, Fox, and Warner Bros. Discovery. The judge indicated FuboTV is likely to win its antitrust argument, stating the partnership would "substantially lessen competition." FuboTV's CEO hailed the decision as a victory for both the company and consumers, while the other companies plan to appeal.

title: Following Four Dream Career Journeys at The Walt Disney Company Brazil
summary: This article highlights the career journeys of four employees at The Walt Disney Company Brazil: Vitória, Akila, Eduardo, and Ana. They all started their paths through programs like the Disney Apprenticeship Program and the Cultural Exchange Program, eventually securing full-time roles. The employees share how their diverse experiences prepared them for their current positions and offer advice to others aspiring to work at Disney, emphasizing the importance of understanding the company's magic and values.

title: Walt Disney tasks Morgan Stanley's Gorman to lead CEO search
summary: Walt Disney has appointed board member and Morgan Stanley's executive chairman, James Gorman, to chair its CEO succession planning committee. This move follows a proxy war with activist investor Nelson Peltz and ongoing scrutiny over Disney's leadership planning as current CEO Bob Iger's contract is set to expire in 2026. The committee, which includes CEOs Mary Barra of General Motors and Calvin McDonald of Lululemon Athletica, is evaluating both internal and external candidates.

title: Akamai: AI Tailwinds Drive Edge Computing and Security Growth
summary: Akamai Technologies (NASDAQ: AKAM) is experiencing significant growth driven by its edge computing and security segments, fueled by AI tailwinds. The company reported strong Q2 2024 earnings, beating consensus estimates and raising its full-year guidance, while its Compute and Security segments now account for 66% of total revenue. Akamai, a leading CDN provider, boasts a vast client list including major streaming services and internet traffic, and is seen as poised for continued growth.

title: The Walt Disney Company Celebrates 85 Years of Groundbreaking Marvel Storytelling with New Brand Spot
summary: The Walt Disney Company released a new brand spot celebrating 85 years of Marvel storytelling, highlighting its legacy in comics and on screen. The spot features archival footage of Stan Lee and Kevin Feige, along with clips from upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe projects. It emphasizes Marvel's cultural impact and anticipation for future groundbreaking stories.

title: Del Monte® Teams Up with Disney and Pixar’s “Inside Out 2” for Exciting Competition
summary: Del Monte® has partnered with Disney and Pixar's "Inside Out 2" to feature film characters on its product packaging across Europe. This collaboration aims to make healthy eating fun for families and includes a competition to win a trip to London, inspired by the movie. Entrants can participate by scanning QR codes on special Del Monte products and answering trivia questions.

title: TRANSFORMERS ONE Gets New IMAX and DOBLY Poster Art
summary: Paramount Pictures has released new IMAX and Dolby posters for the upcoming film "Transformers One," set to hit theaters on September 20th. The movie will explore the origin story of Optimus Prime and Megatron, detailing their transition from allies to adversaries. While the author expresses some reservations about the footage released, director Josh Cooley promises real danger and epic scale in the film, which stars Chris Hemsworth and Brian Tyree Henry.

title: Landsea Homes Sells Out at Greenfield Village near Disney in Central Florida
summary: Landsea Homes Corporation has announced that all 136 single-family homes at its Greenfield Village community in Davenport, Florida, near Walt Disney World, have been sold. The community offered resort-style amenities and a vibrant lifestyle, attracting homebuyers to its prime location. Although Greenfield Village is sold out, Landsea Homes still has properties available in other Davenport communities like Legacy Landings, Preservation Pointe, and Horse Creek at Crosswinds.

title: Here’s What You Need to Know About the Dispute Between DirecTV and The Walt Disney Company
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced that millions of DirecTV customers are experiencing a blackout of Disney-owned channels, including ESPN and ABC, due to DirecTV's refusal to agree to a fair marketplace-based agreement. Disney emphasized the indisputable value of its content portfolio and stated its commitment to flexible distribution models, urging DirecTV to quickly finalize a deal to restore programming. The dispute affects major sports and entertainment events like the US Open, college football, and the NFL season.

title: PodcastOne Names Steve Lehman Vice Chairman to Drive Its Mergers, Acquisitions and Strategy Efforts
summary: PodcastOne has appointed Steve Lehman as its Vice Chairman to spearhead mergers, acquisitions, and strategy, focusing on both organic and inorganic growth. Lehman brings extensive experience from heading Nasdaq and NYSE companies, as well as start-ups in media, entertainment, and tech industries, which aligns with PodcastOne's long-term growth vision. His role will involve advising senior management on M&A efforts, overall strategy, and increasing shareholder value.

title: Is Netflix (NFLX) Overpriced? A Deep Dive Into Its 2024 Financials and Growth Prospects.
summary: This article analyzes Netflix (NFLX)'s 2024 financial performance and growth prospects, highlighting its strong subscriber and revenue growth, but questioning its high valuation. It delves into the company's decision to stop reporting subscriber numbers, its elevated P/E ratio compared to competitors like Disney (DIS), and its strategic differentiators. The author ultimately suggests Netflix's stock may be overvalued, recommending a more cautious approach for investors.

title: Hidden Roku trick gives you 200,000 free movies and TV shows plus 260 channels
summary: Roku and Amazon Fire TV users can access over 200,000 free movies and TV episodes, along with 260 live channels, through Tubi. This ad-supported streaming service has tied with Disney+ in hours watched, making it highly popular. Tubi continuously adds new content, including dedicated channels for popular TV shows and content from major networks like A&E and the History Channel.

title: JPMorgan Chase to equip 140K workers with generative AI tool
summary: JPMorgan Chase is rolling out its AI assistant LLM Suite to 140,000 employees and expects up to $2 billion in AI-related upside from this and other initiatives. The bank's President and COO, Daniel Pinto, stated that these efforts aim to drive operational efficiencies over the next three to five years, including processing more for the same money or spending less. This transformation is part of a broader technology modernization effort and includes significant investment in fraud prevention.

title: Disney and Pixar’s ‘Inside Out 2’ Begins Streaming on Disney+ September 25
summary: Disney and Pixar's "Inside Out 2," the highest-grossing animated film of all time, will begin streaming on Disney+ on September 25. The film revisits Riley's mind as new emotions, including Anxiety, arrive. To coincide with the release, Disney+ is offering a special Blockbuster Offer for new and returning subscribers.

title: MotoGP is "exciting product" for Liberty Media, says CEO Greg Maffei
summary: Liberty Media CEO Greg Maffei has described MotoGP as "an unbelievably exciting product" as the company prepares to finalize its €4.2 billion acquisition of the global motorcycling series by the end of the year. Maffei expressed enthusiasm for growing MotoGP, particularly in the US, by leveraging strategies similar to those used for Formula One, such as telling compelling stories and improving broadcast presentation. He also confirmed that Lewis Hamilton had shown interest in purchasing a MotoGP team following the acquisition announcement.

title: Six Flags Reports Short-Term Theme Park Hiatus, All Guests Recieve Social Media Refusal Alert
summary: Kings Dominion, a Six Flags park, announced a temporary closure for a private event from September 14-15, leading to an 11-day hiatus due to seasonal operating hours. Despite this, Kings Dominion is making positive headlines with the upcoming 2025 debut of Rapterra, the world's tallest and longest-launched wing coaster. This news follows the recent merger of Six Flags and Cedar Fair, creating the largest amusement park operator in the U.S., which has sparked both optimism and concerns about park individuality and pricing among enthusiasts.

title: DIRECTV and The Walt Disney Company Reach Agreement in Principle for Distribution of Disney’s Linear Networks and Direct-to-Consumer Services
summary: DIRECTV and The Walt Disney Company have reached an agreement in principle for the distribution of Disney's linear networks and direct-to-consumer services, leading to the immediate restoration of all Disney channels for DIRECTV customers. This new multi-year contract will include Disney's full portfolio of networks, genre-specific options, and the future ESPN flagship direct-to-consumer offering. The agreement provides greater choice, value, and flexibility to customers, allowing them to tailor their video experience.

title: The Walt Disney Company Earns a Record-Breaking 60 Wins for the 76th Emmy® Awards
summary: The Walt Disney Company achieved a record-breaking 60 Emmy Awards at the 76th annual ceremony, with FX leading its brands with 36 wins, largely driven by "Shōgun" and "The Bear." "Shōgun" set a new TV Academy record with 19 wins for a series in a single year, and "The Bear" broke its own record with 11 wins. Disney's streaming platforms, led by Hulu and Disney+, collectively secured 59 wins, demonstrating the company's broad success across television and film.

title: The Walt Disney Company Makes History with Record-Breaking 60 Emmy® Awards
summary: The Walt Disney Company achieved a record-breaking 60 Emmy® Awards at the 76th annual ceremony across its various brands and platforms, with FX leading its divisions with 36 awards. Key wins included 19 Emmys for Shōgun, setting a new Television Academy record, and 11 Emmys for The Bear, while also recognizing groundbreaking wins for actors Anna Sawai and Liza Colón-Zayas. This success highlights Disney's widespread excellence in television production, spanning drama, comedy, documentaries, and more.

title: The Walt Disney Company makes history with record-breaking 60 Emmys
summary: The Walt Disney Company set a new record by winning 60 Emmys across its brands and studios. FX led the wins with 36 awards, with "Shōgun" breaking a TV Academy record for most wins in a single year with 19, and "The Bear" setting a new record for a comedy series with 11 wins. The awards also saw historic wins for actors of Asian and Latina descent.

title: TelevisaUnivision replaces CEO; source cites lagging results
summary: TelevisaUnivision has replaced its CEO, Wade Davis, with Daniel Alegre, citing lagging results and a loss of confidence from stakeholders. Davis, who led the company since its formation in 2021 and oversaw the launch of the streaming service ViX, will transition to a vice chairman role. Alegre, formerly of Yuga Labs, Activision Blizzard, and Google, will take over as CEO, with expectations to drive stronger growth, particularly in the U.S. market.

title: Jared Bush Named Chief Creative Officer of Walt Disney Animation Studios
summary: Jared Bush has been named Chief Creative Officer (CCO) of Walt Disney Animation Studios, reporting to Disney Entertainment Co-Chairman Alan Bergman. Former CCO Jennifer Lee will return to full-time filmmaking, focusing on the Frozen franchise, including directing and writing Frozen 3 and writing Frozen 4. Clark Spencer continues as President of Walt Disney Animation Studios, while Bush will oversee the studio's creative output, including upcoming films like Moana 2 and Zootopia 2.

title: Disney Animation Shakes Things Up: Jared Bush Becomes Chief Creative Officer, Jennifer Lee Steps Back To Prepare For Frozen Sequels
summary: Walt Disney Company has appointed Academy Award-winning filmmaker Jared Bush as Chief Creative Officer (CCO) of Walt Disney Animation Studios. Jennifer Lee will step back from her CCO role to focus full-time on filmmaking, specifically directing and writing "Frozen 3" and co-writing "Frozen 4." Bush, an Academy Award winner for "Encanto," will now manage the creative output of the animation studio across films, series, and related projects.

title: Ackman’s Pershing Reports 38% Stake in Oakland A’s Las Vegas Team
summary: Billionaire fund manager Bill Ackman's Pershing Square Capital Management has reported a 38% equity stake in Seaport Entertainment, owner of the Oakland A’s Triple-A affiliate, the Las Vegas Aviators, and various real estate assets. Seaport Entertainment became publicly traded after spinning off from Howard Hughes Corp. in August and saw a significant portion of its 2023 revenue, $33.4 million, generated by the Aviators and its stadium ownership. The article highlights Seaport's other holdings, including Manhattan's Seaport and a stake in Jean-Georges Restaurants, while also noting MLB's influence over the Aviators' operations, including a clause preventing any single entity from controlling more than 50% of Seaport's stock without MLB approval.

title: Lindblad Expeditions Puts National Geographic First In New Co-Brand
summary: Lindblad Expeditions and National Geographic have launched a new co-brand, "National Geographic-Lindblad Expeditions," reversing their previous naming convention to emphasize the widely recognized National Geographic brand. This strategic rebranding aims to attract more travelers and is part of an extended partnership with The Walt Disney Company until at least 2040. The new identity will be rolled out across marketing channels by year-end, with a major campaign in early 2025 and implementation on their fleet starting next year.

title: 'Inside Out 2' Is the No. 1 Film Premiere on Disney+ in 2024, Driving 30.5 Million Views Globally in 5 Days
summary: Disney and Pixar's "Inside Out 2" made a record-breaking premiere on Disney+, achieving 30.5 million views globally within five days and becoming the No. 1 film premiere on the platform in 2024. The film also holds the record for the No. 1 theatrical film premiere on Disney+ since "Encanto" and the No. 1 film premiere of all time in EMEA and LATAM. Its success also led to over 121 million views of the original "Inside Out" movie on Disney+ as viewers revisited the first installment.

title: Sony Pictures CEO Tony Vinciquerra to step down, succeeded by Ravi Ahuja
summary: Tony Vinciquerra, the current Chairman and CEO of Sony Pictures Entertainment, will step down in January 2025, handing over the reins to Ravi Ahuja. Ahuja, who previously ran Sony’s global television studios and has a background with Disney and Fox, was promoted to COO in April, signaling this succession. Vinciquerra is credited with turning Sony Pictures into a profitable "arms dealer" in the streaming wars by producing content for various platforms rather than launching its own

title: Focus: MercadoLibre, Latam's Amazon.com rival, rides high with AI, loans, drones
summary: MercadoLibre, Latin America's e-commerce giant, is expanding rapidly by leveraging AI, offering loans, and exploring drone delivery to enhance its ecosystem for shoppers and sellers. The company is using its extensive user data to provide instant credit, fueling its growth and solidifying its position as the region's most valuable firm despite competition from other fintechs. Investors are bullish on MercadoLibre's outlook, with strong growth in areas like credit and plans to triple active users.

title: Steph Curry, Chinese Stimulus Revive Under Armour, Amer as Stocks Gain
summary: Under Armour and Amer Sports experienced significant stock gains in September, contributing to the Sportico Sports Stock Index reaching a 13-month high. This surge was primarily driven by Steph Curry's successful tour of China for Under Armour, which boosted brand heat and sales, and substantial Chinese government stimulus measures that encouraged consumer spending. Additionally, sports betting companies also saw double-digit gains due to a strong start to the NFL season and favorable interest rate conditions.

title: ESPN BET Retail Sportsbook Unveiled at Hollywood Casino Columbus
summary: Hollywood Casino Columbus has unveiled its new ESPN BET Sportsbook, enhancing the sports betting and viewing experience for guests. This rebranding strengthens the connection between PENN Entertainment's retail casino and its online sports betting platform, ESPN BET, which launched in November 2023 and is available in 19 jurisdictions. The new sportsbook features numerous betting kiosks and windows, large TV walls, and a gameday menu.

title: Another Round of Layoffs on the Way for The Walt Disney Company
summary: The Walt Disney Company is planning another round of layoffs, impacting approximately 75 employees from ABC News and local stations, following previous reductions in corporate employees and Disney Entertainment Television. This move is part of ongoing efforts to streamline operations amidst a challenging operating environment. Company executives expect the layoffs will not affect national or local programming or specific employee teams.

title: The Walt Disney Company’s Shift Away From Walt Disney’s Vision
summary: The Walt Disney Company is experiencing a significant decline in fan loyalty, particularly among "Disney adults," due to past leadership decisions, notably under former CEO Bob Chapek, and a perceived shift away from Walt Disney's original vision. Despite Bob Iger's return, skepticism remains as fans feel the company is prioritizing financial recovery over the cherished legacy and visitor experience, leading to an erosion of the "Disney magic." The company faces challenges in reconnecting with its core values and fanbase amidst a competitive market.

title: How Disney Consumer Products Delivers Culture-Driving Collaborations
summary: Disney Consumer Products (DCP) leverages Disney's rich legacy and intellectual property to create high-impact collaborations with modern fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands like Coperni, Pleasing, Balmain, Kith, and Gap. These partnerships aim to connect with global audiences, inspire artists, and offer unexpected products that introduce Disney to new demographics. The collaborations are launched with unique campaigns, showcasing creativity and artistry to maximize their reach and cultural impact.

title: Disney+, Hulu, or ESPN+ Now Included with Boost by Kroger Plus Annual Membership
summary: The Kroger Co. announced that its Boost by Kroger Plus annual membership will now include Disney streaming options at no additional cost. Members can choose between Disney+ Basic (With Ads), Hulu (With Ads), or an ESPN+ subscription, enhancing the existing savings on fuel and groceries. This collaboration aims to provide greater value and convenience for Boost members.

title: Making Magic as Interns with The Walt Disney Company Australia
summary: This article highlights the experiences of two interns, Saynab and Spencer, with The Walt Disney Company Australia. They share how their dynamic roles, supportive environment, and unique opportunities led to personal and professional growth. The piece emphasizes the impact of Disney's internship program in providing valuable career starts and fostering a magical company culture.

title: Kartoon Channel and Samsung TV Plus Launch Kids Free Streaming Channel in India, the United Kingdom, Italy, and Spain
summary: Kartoon Studios has launched a new "Video Game Heroes" FAST channel for kids through Samsung TV Plus in the UK, Italy, and Spain, and in India via a joint venture with Power Kids. This expansion will reach over 1.5 billion new viewers with gaming-led content, including shows like *Kidaverse Roblox Rumble*, *Sonic X*, and *Donkey Kong Country*, all curated to be family-friendly and child-safe. The initiative aims to provide safe and entertaining content that caters to children's interest in gaming, aligning with parents' desire for secure viewing environments.

title: Kroger gives its membership program a streaming boost
summary: Kroger has enhanced its annual Kroger Boost membership program by adding Disney streaming options, allowing members to choose between Disney+ Basic with ads, Hulu with ads, or ESPN+. This move aligns Kroger with competitors like Walmart and Amazon, who also incorporate streaming perks into their subscription services to increase perceived value and member engagement. The new benefit provides added value at no extra cost for members, with different subscription options depending on their annual Boost plan.

title: The world's top 10 theme park operators
summary: This article identifies the top 10 theme park operators globally based on 2023 attendance figures from the TEA/AECOM Theme Index and Museum Index. It details each company's portfolio of parks, their visitor numbers, and recent developments or future expansion plans, highlighting the industry's shift towards multinational corporations focused on immersive experiences.

title: Advertisers are targeting horror-loving younger audiences in theaters
summary: Advertisers are increasingly targeting younger, horror-loving audiences in theaters, recognizing that this demographic is often difficult to reach through traditional advertising channels. The success of indie horror films like "Longlegs" highlights the effectiveness of out-of-home and in-theater advertising for engaging these cord-cutting, ad-avoiding consumers. Cinema advertising companies like Screenvision Media and National CineMedia are capitalizing on this trend, as horror films create cultural moments that attract a young and engaged audience.

title: Instagram and TikTok Remain the Most Popular Social Apps Among Teens
summary: A Piper Sandler survey of over 13,000 U.S. teens indicates that Instagram is still the most used social app, despite TikTok being preferred for entertainment. While Snapchat has declined, Pinterest and Facebook have seen slight resurgences in teen interest. These insights suggest that targeting young audiences should still primarily focus on Instagram and TikTok, with potential to explore Pinterest and Facebook's AI ads.

title: Disney, Hershey execs share how holiday marketing campaigns are evolving
summary: Executives from Disney and Hershey discussed at Advertising Week how they are evolving holiday marketing campaigns to engage audiences through cultural moments beyond traditional advertising. Hershey partners with Disney for its key seasonal events like Halloween, focusing on impressive content integration rather than just ad spots. Both companies emphasize creating authentic, real-time campaigns and leveraging unique cultural moments to drive significant ROI and revenue growth.

title: NetEase Games and Marvel Games Reveal MARVEL Mystic Mayhem, A Mobile, Team-Based Tactical RPG Set in the Heart of the Marvel Universe
summary: NetEase Games and Marvel Games have announced MARVEL Mystic Mayhem, a new free-to-play mobile tactical RPG. Players will assemble teams of Super Heroes to battle Nightmare, the lord of the Dream Dimension, as he turns dreams into dangerous dungeons. The game will feature characters like Scarlet Witch, Moon Knight, and Captain America, with Doctor Strange and Sleepwalker assisting the heroes.

title: New Mobile RPG 'MARVEL Mystic Mayhem' Is Set in the Heart of the Marvel Universe
summary: NetEase Games and Marvel Games have announced their new collaboration, MARVEL Mystic Mayhem, a free-to-play mobile tactical RPG. Players will join iconic Super Heroes like Scarlet Witch, Moon Knight, and Captain America to fight Nightmare, the lord of the Dream Dimension, who is turning their dreams into dangerous dungeons. Doctor Strange and Sleepwalker will power their allies with dream energy to form three-hero teams and delve into these nightmares to save reality.

title: Macy's and Disney Celebrate Magic and Legacy with a New Holiday Collaboration and the Balloon Debut of Minnie Mouse at the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
summary: Macy's and Disney are collaborating on a new holiday collection and the debut of a Minnie Mouse character balloon at the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. This partnership celebrates a 90-year relationship between the two brands, featuring exclusive artwork by Disney's Jeff Shelly and a limited-edition product line available at Macy's stores nationwide. Dedicated Mickey and Minnie Shops will open in 200 Macy's stores, including a special interactive experience at the Herald Square flagship.

title: Apple celebrates 10 years of Apple Pay
summary: Apple is celebrating the 10th anniversary of Apple Pay, highlighting its growth to hundreds of millions of users in 78 markets and its role in secure and private transactions. Jennifer Bailey, Apple’s vice president of Apple Pay and Apple Wallet, discusses new features like rewards and installment loans, and the ongoing vision to expand Apple Wallet's capabilities to replace physical wallets. The company attributes Apple Pay's success to its ease of use, privacy, and security, with high customer satisfaction rates.

title: Mandalorian N-1 Starfighter Official Images & Details for Transformers x Star Wars Collaborative
summary: Hasbro has unveiled official images and details for the new Transformers x Star Wars Collaborative The Mandalorian N-1 Starfighter. This exclusive 7.5-inch figure converts from character mode to starfighter alt mode in 37 steps and comes with multiple accessories, including blast effects, blasters, a shield, and a cape that doubles as a display stand. It is available for pre-order at $54.99 USD and is expected to ship in February 2025.

title: Into The Cineverse With 'Terrifier 3's Distributor: How A Six-Figure Investment Turned Into Tens Of Millions In Box Office
summary: Cineverse, the distributor of 'Terrifier 3,' turned a six-figure marketing investment and a multi-million-dollar loan into nearly $30 million in box office revenue for the film. The company, formerly a cinema equipment seller, has pivoted to a streaming-centric operation with a "Moneyball approach" to film distribution, focusing on cost controls and leveraging its horror-centric assets like Screambox and Bloody Disgusting. This strategy demonstrates a successful model for indie distribution, emphasizing partnerships with producers and de-risking P&A and marketing spend.

title: The Walt Disney Company Board Names James P. Gorman as Chairman, Effective January 2, 2025
summary: The Walt Disney Company Board of Directors has named James P. Gorman as Chairman, effective January 2, 2025, succeeding Mark G. Parker.
